records.definition: اتفاقيّة بين جهة حكوميّة محددة وواحد أو أكثر من الموردين أو المقاولين أو المتعهدين، تتضمن شروط وأحكام العقود التي ستتم ترسيتها أثناء مدة معينة، وعادةً ما تكون مخصصة لتلبية احتياجات تلك الجهة الحكوميّة فقط.
records.english_definition: A formal agreement between a specific government entity and one or more suppliers, contractors, or service providers, containing the terms and conditions of contracts to be awarded during a specified period, typically limited to meeting the specific needs of that government entity only.

translations.word: Government Entity-Specific Framework Agreement|A formal agreement between a specific government entity and one or more suppliers, contractors, or service providers, containing the terms and conditions of contracts to be awarded during a specified period, typically limited to meeting the specific needs of that government entity only.

records.definition: اتفاقيّة بين جهة أو أكثر من الجهات الحكوميّة وواحد أو أكثر من الموردين أو المقاولين أو المتعهدين، تتضمن شروط العقود وأحكامها التي ستتم ترسيتها أثناء مدة معينة، وتغطي جميع الجهات الحكوميّة المشتركة بهدف تحقيق وفورات الحجم وتقليل التكاليف والإجراءات، ويجوز لأي مورِّد أو مقاول أو متعهِّد طلب الانضمام إليها في أي وقت خلال مدة سريانها.
records.english_definition: A formal agreement between one or more government entities and one or more suppliers, contractors, or service providers, containing the terms and conditions of contracts to be awarded during a specified period, covering all participating government entities to achieve economies of scale and reduce costs and procedures, and where any supplier, contractor, or service provider may request to join at any time during the term of the agreement.

translations.word: Unified Procurement Framework Agreement|A formal agreement between one or more government entities and one or more suppliers, contractors, or service providers, containing the terms and conditions of contracts to be awarded during a specified period, covering all participating government entities to achieve economies of scale and reduce costs and procedures, and where any supplier, contractor, or service provider may request to join at any time during the term of the agreement.

records.definition: اتفاقيّة بين جهة أو أكثر من الجهات الحكوميّة وواحد أو أكثر من الموردين أو المقاولين أو المتعهدين وتتضمن شروط العقود وأحكامها التي ستتم ترسيتها أثناء مدة معينة، ولا يجوز ضمّ أي مورد أو مقاول أو متعهد إليها ما لم يكن طرفًا فيها عند إبرامها.
records.english_definition: A formal agreement between one or more government entities and suppliers or contractors, containing the conditions and regulations of the contract, where no additional suppliers or contractors may join once the agreement has been concluded.

translations.word: Closed Framework Agreement|A formal agreement between one or more government entities and suppliers or contractors, containing the conditions and regulations of the contract, where no additional suppliers or contractors may join once the agreement has been concluded.

records.definition: اتفاقيّة بين جهة أو أكثر من الجهات الحكوميّة وواحد أو أكثر من الموردين أو المقاولين أو المتعهدين وتتضمن شروط وأحكام العقود التي ستتم ترسيتها أثناء مدة معينة، ويجوز لأي مورد أو مقاول أو متعهد طلب الانضمام إليها في أي وقت خلال مدة سريانها.
records.english_definition: A formal agreement between one or more government organizations and suppliers or contractors, containing the conditions and regulations of the contract, which allows additional suppliers or contractors to join during the term of the agreement.

translations.word: Open Framework Agreement|A formal agreement between one or more government organizations and suppliers or contractors, containing the conditions and regulations of the contract, which allows additional suppliers or contractors to join during the term of the agreement.

records.definition: الاتفاقيّة الجمركيّة بشأن إذن المرور للإدخال المؤقت للبضائع التي أقرها مجلس التعاون الجمركيّ في بروكسل في العام 1961م.
records.english_definition: The customs convention on the Temporary Admission (ATA) carnet adopted by the Customs Cooperation Council in Brussels in 1961.

translations.word: Temporary Admission (ATA) Convention|The customs convention on the Temporary Admission (ATA) carnet adopted by the Customs Cooperation Council in Brussels in 1961.

records.definition: اتفاقيّة بين ممثلين مفوضين للدول الأطراف في اتفاقيّة دولية تقضي بالتبادل التلقائيّ للتقارير الخاصة بكل دولة بين الدول الأطراف في الاتفاقيّة.
records.english_definition: An agreement between authorized representatives of Countries Parties or jurisdictions that are parties to an international convention providing for the automatic exchange of country-specific reports between States Parties to the convention.

translations.word: Qualified Competent Authority Agreement|An agreement between authorized representatives of Countries Parties or jurisdictions that are parties to an international convention providing for the automatic exchange of country-specific reports between States Parties to the convention.

records.definition: الوثيقة التي يبرمها المساهمون في الكيان ذي الأغراض الخاصة، تُحدد طريقة عملهم معًا لإدارته.
records.english_definition: The document that the special purpose vehicle (SPV) equity providers enter into, setting out how they will work together to manage it.

translations.word: Shareholders Agreement|The document that the special purpose vehicle (SPV) equity providers enter into, setting out how they will work together to manage it.

records.definition: اتفاقيّة داخلية بين الإدارات أو الفرق تحدد المسؤوليات وتوقعات الخدمة.
records.english_definition: An internal agreement between departments or teams that defines responsibilities and service expectations.

translations.word: Operational-Level Agreement (OLA)|An internal agreement between departments or teams that defines responsibilities and service expectations.

records.definition: اتفاقيّة تهدف لتحسين الامتثال الضريبيّ الدولي، تقضي بتبادل معلومات الحسابات الماليّة بصفة دورية.
records.english_definition: An agreement to improve international tax compliance, which provides for the exchange of financial accounts information on a regular basis.

translations.word: Exchange of Information Agreement|An agreement to improve international tax compliance, which provides for the exchange of financial accounts information on a regular basis.

records.definition: العلاقة التعاقدية بين أعضاء التحالف، وهي تحدد بالتفصيل طريقة تقاسم المسؤوليات والمخاطر والترسيّات وتوزيعها على أعضاء الاتفاقيّة.
records.english_definition: The contractual relationship between consortium members. Sets out in detail how responsibilities, risks, and rewards will be shared and/or allocated among the members.

translations.word: Consortium Agreement|The contractual relationship between consortium members. Sets out in detail how responsibilities, risks, and rewards will be shared and/or allocated among the members.

records.definition: مجموعة من الوثائق يُمنَح القرض بموجبها لتطوير أحد الأصول، وتشمل "وثائق / اتفاقيّة القرض"، و"اتفاقيّة التمويل" و"اتفاقيات الديون".
records.english_definition: Set of documents under which a loan is provided for development of the asset. Includes “loan documents/agreement”, “finance agreement”, and “debt agreements.”

translations.word: Financing Agreement|Set of documents under which a loan is provided for development of the asset. Includes “loan documents/agreement”, “finance agreement”, and “debt agreements.”

records.definition: عقد قانوني بين بائع ووكالة أو ممثِّل، يحدد الشروط والأحكام الخاصة ببيع المنتجات أو الخدمات.
records.english_definition: A legal contract between a seller and an agency or representative, outlining the terms and conditions for the sale of products or services.

translations.word: Sale Agency Agreement|A legal contract between a seller and an agency or representative, outlining the terms and conditions for the sale of products or services.

records.definition: تأثير الأنشطة أو السياسات أو الأحداث الاقتصادية على الشركات والقطاعات والأفراد.
records.english_definition: The effect of economic activities, policies, or events on businesses, industries, and individuals.

translations.word: Economic Impact|The effect of economic activities, policies, or events on businesses, industries, and individuals.

variants.example: التقرير يوضح التأثير الاقتصادي للمشروع الجديد.

records.definition: القيمة المقدّرة أو المحقّقة للتكاليف أو الوفورات الناتجة عن تنفيذ التوصيات أو القرارات، بما يعكس التغير في الوضع الماليّ للجهة من حيث النفقات أو الإيرادات أو الكفاءة الماليّة.
records.english_definition: The estimated or realized value of the costs or savings resulting from the implementation of recommendations or decisions, reflecting the change in the financial position of the entity in terms of expenses, revenues, or financial efficiency.

translations.word: Financial Impact|The estimated or realized value of the costs or savings resulting from the implementation of recommendations or decisions, reflecting the change in the financial position of the entity in terms of expenses, revenues, or financial efficiency.

variants.example: تم قياس التأثير المالي للقرار بدقة.

records.definition: الراتـب الأساسيّ أو الأجـر بالإضافة إلى جميع الزيـادات الأخرى المتراكمة المحـددة للموظف مقابل جهـد يبذلـه فـي العمل، أو المخاطـرة في أداء عملـه، أو التي يقررهـا صاحب العمـل للعمل المنجز بموجـب عقـد العمل، أو لائحـة تنظيم العمل.
records.english_definition: The base pay plus all other accrued increases determined for the employee in exchange for an effort made by him at work, or risk in the performance of his work or which the Employer decides for the work performed under the employment contract or the employment regulation system.

translations.word: Actual Pay|The base pay plus all other accrued increases determined for the employee in exchange for an effort made by him at work, or risk in the performance of his work or which the Employer decides for the work performed under the employment contract or the employment regulation system.

variants.example: الراتب الفعلي للموظف يشمل المزايا الإضافية.

records.definition: إجراء جمركي يتم بموجبه فرز البضائع المستوردة الخاضعة لسيطرة الجمارك في مكان محدد (مستودع جمركي) من دون الضرائب ورسوم الاستيراد.
records.english_definition: A Customs procedure under which imported goods are stored under Customs control in a designated place (a Customs warehouse) without payment of import duties and taxes.

translations.word: Customs Warehousing Procedure|A Customs procedure under which imported goods are stored under Customs control in a designated place (a Customs warehouse) without payment of import duties and taxes.

records.definition: قرار تتخذه وكالة تصنيف الائتمان لتغيير التصنيف الائتماني أو التوقعات المتعلقة بجهة أو أداة ماليّة؛ مما يؤثر عادة على تصورات المستثمرين وشروطهم.
records.english_definition: A decision made by a credit rating agency to change the credit rating or outlook of an entity or financial instrument, often impacting investor perceptions and terms.

translations.word: Rating Procedure|A decision made by a credit rating agency to change the credit rating or outlook of an entity or financial instrument, often impacting investor perceptions and terms.

records.definition: مجموعة من الخطوات أو التدابير المحددة التي يجب اتباعها لإكمال مهمة معينة، أو عملية، أو  إجراء تشغيلي بصورةٍ فعّالة ومتسقة.
records.english_definition: A set of established steps or actions that should be followed to complete a specific task, process, or operation efficiently and consistently.

translations.word: Procedures|A set of established steps or actions that should be followed to complete a specific task, process, or operation efficiently and consistently.

records.definition: مجموعة من العمليات التي تتبعها المنظمات والمؤسسات لضمان تنفيذ المهامّ والأنشطة بشكل موحَّد ومتّسق وفعّال.
records.english_definition: Standardized processes that organizations follow to ensure efficiency, consistency, and compliance.

translations.word: Business Procedures|Standardized processes that organizations follow to ensure efficiency, consistency, and compliance.

records.definition: حق هيئة الزكاة والضريبة والجمارك في إجراء الفحص والربط للتحقق من وفاء المكلّف بالالتزامات المفروضة عليه بمقتضى نظام ضريبة الدخل، وتصحيح أو تعديل الضريبة المبينة في الإقرار، بما يجعلها متوافقة مع أحكام النظام، مع التزام المكلف بالتعاون مع فاحصي الهيئة، وتزويدهم بالمعلومات، والمستندات عند طلبهم وله الحق في إجراء الربط الضريبيّ إذا لم يقدّم المكلّف إقراره.
records.english_definition: The Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) has the right to conduct an examination and assessment to verify that the taxpayer has fulfilled the obligations imposed on him under the Income Tax Law, and to correct or amend the tax stated in the declaration, making it consistent with the provisions of the Law, with the taxpayer being obligated to cooperate with the ZATCA examiners and provide them with information and documents upon request. He has the right to conduct a tax assessment if the taxpayer does not submit his declaration.

translations.word: Examination and  Assessment Procedures|The Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) has the right to conduct an examination and assessment to verify that the taxpayer has fulfilled the obligations imposed on him under the Income Tax Law, and to correct or amend the tax stated in the declaration, making it consistent with the provisions of the Law, with the taxpayer being obligated to cooperate with the ZATCA examiners and provide them with information and documents upon request. He has the right to conduct a tax assessment if the taxpayer does not submit his declaration.

records.definition: سلسلة من الأعمال والخطوات والمراحل التي يتخذها المصدر، ويترتب عليها زيادة عدد أوراقه الماليّة المصدرة أو تخفيضها أو تعديل قيمتها الاسمية، ويشمل ذلك - على سبيل المثال لا الحصر - زيادة رأس مال المصدر وتخفيضه.
records.english_definition: Actions taken by an issuer which lead to increasing or decreasing the number of its securities or changing its nominal value including, for example, increasing or decreasing its capital.

translations.word: Corporate Actions|Actions taken by an issuer which lead to increasing or decreasing the number of its securities or changing its nominal value including, for example, increasing or decreasing its capital.

records.definition: الآليات والخطوات المتعلقة بإدراج الأوراق الماليّة في السوق وتداولها لتنفيذ الصفقات من تسوية، ومقاصّة، وتسجيل ملكية الورقة الماليّة، ونقلها، وإيداعها.
records.english_definition: The mechanisms relevant to listing and trading securities to execute transactions including settlement, clearing, ownership registration, transfer and deposit of securities.

translations.word: Technical Procedures|The mechanisms relevant to listing and trading securities to execute transactions including settlement, clearing, ownership registration, transfer and deposit of securities.

records.definition: جميع العمليات التي يجب تنفيذها من قبل الأشخاص المعنيين، ومن قبل الجمارك لغرض الالتزام بقانون الجمارك.
records.english_definition: All the operations which must be carried out by the persons concerned and by the Customs in order to comply with the Customs law.

translations.word: Customs Formalities|All the operations which must be carried out by the persons concerned and by the Customs in order to comply with the Customs law.

records.definition: إجماليّ الدَّين المستحق على حكومة ما شاملًا الدَّين المحليّ والدَّين الخارجيّ قبل النظر في الأصول أو الديون لدى الأجهزة الحكوميّة.
records.english_definition: The total outstanding debt of a government, including both domestic and external debt, before considering assets or debt held by government agencies.

translations.word: Government Gross Public Debt|The total outstanding debt of a government, including both domestic and external debt, before considering assets or debt held by government agencies.

records.definition: قيمة أصول الصندوق التي تُقَيَّم وفقًا لكيفية تقييم الأصول المذكورة في شروط الصندوق وأحكامه.
records.english_definition: The fund’s assets value that are valued based on the method of assets valuation stipulated in the fund’s terms and conditions.

translations.word: Fund's Total Assets Value|The fund’s assets value that are valued based on the method of assets valuation stipulated in the fund’s terms and conditions.

records.definition: الآلية التي يكون بموجبها العميل الخاضع للضريبة ملزمًا بدفع الضريبة المستحقة نيابة عن المورد، كما يكون مسؤولًا عن جميع الالتزامات المنصوص عليها في الاتفاقيّة (الاتفاقيّة الموحدة لضريبة القيمة المضافة لدول مجلس التعاون لدول الخليج العربية)، والقانون المحليّ (نظام ضريبة القيمة المضافة، ولائحته التنفيذية).
records.english_definition: The mechanism by which the taxable customer is obligated to pay the tax due on be- half of the supplier, and he is also responsible for all the obligations provided for in the agreement (the Unified Agreement for VAT of the GCC) and the local VAT law and its applicable regulation.

translations.word: Reverse Charge Mechanism|The mechanism by which the taxable customer is obligated to pay the tax due on be- half of the supplier, and he is also responsible for all the obligations provided for in the agreement (the Unified Agreement for VAT of the GCC) and the local VAT law and its applicable regulation.

records.definition: مقياس احتماليّة تخلف المقترض عن سداد التزامات دينه، وغالبًا ما ترد في شكل نسبة مئوية ويستخدمها المستثمرون لقياس المخاطر.
records.english_definition: A measure of the likelihood that a borrower will default on its debt obligations. It is often expressed as a percentage and is used by investors to gauge risk.

translations.word: Default Probability|A measure of the likelihood that a borrower will default on its debt obligations. It is often expressed as a percentage and is used by investors to gauge risk.

variants.ambiguity_note: اختصار قد يدل على معانٍ أخرى خارج المخاطر الائتمانية

records.definition: حدث أو ناتج من المستبعَد بشدة وقوعه، أو فرصة حدوثه ضئيلة جدًا.
records.english_definition: An event or outcome is highly unlikely to occur or has a very low chance of happening.

translations.word: Insignificant Probability|An event or outcome is highly unlikely to occur or has a very low chance of happening.

records.definition: احتماليّة وقوع حدث مع درجة من عدم اليقين تتأرجح بين الاحتمالات المنخفضة والعالية.
records.english_definition: The likelihood of an event occurring with a degree of uncertainty that falls between low and high probabilities.

translations.word: Moderate Probability|The likelihood of an event occurring with a degree of uncertainty that falls between low and high probabilities.

records.definition: النظام المصرفي المركزي للولايات المتحدة الأمريكية المسؤول عن إدارة السياسة النقديّة وتنظيم الصناعة الماليّة.
records.english_definition: The central banking system of the United States responsible for conducting monetary policy and regulating the financial industry.

translations.word: Federal Reserve|The central banking system of the United States responsible for conducting monetary policy and regulating the financial industry.

records.definition: الأموال التي تحتفظ بها الحكومة لدى البنك المركزي السعودي بهدف توفير غطاء ماليّ لمواجهة الطوارئ، ودعم استدامة الماليّة العامة على المدى المتوسط والطويل.
records.english_definition: The funds held by the government at the Saudi Central Bank to provide a financial buffer for emergencies and support the sustainability of public finances in the medium and long term.

translations.word: Government Reserves|The funds held by the government at the Saudi Central Bank to provide a financial buffer for emergencies and support the sustainability of public finances in the medium and long term.

records.definition: التلاعب بالمعلومات أو الأصول أو العمليات بقصد الحصول على مزايا غير عادلة؛ ما يؤدي غالبًا إلى تكبد خسائر ماليّة وعواقب قانونية.
records.english_definition: The act of deceiving or manipulating information, assets, or processes with the intent to gain an unfair advantage, often resulting in financial losses or legal consequences.

translations.word: Fraud|The act of deceiving or manipulating information, assets, or processes with the intent to gain an unfair advantage, often resulting in financial losses or legal consequences.

variants.ambiguity_note: قد تعني النصب النحوي أو النُّصُب (التمثال)
variants.example: تم ضبط صاحب المتجر على عملية نصب.

records.definition: قطاع شؤون العقارات الخاصة في الهيئة العامة لعقارات الدولة.
records.english_definition: Sector of Private Properties Affairs in the State Properties General Authority.

translations.word: Ehkaam|Sector of Private Properties Affairs in the State Properties General Authority.

records.definition: مجموعة من الأحكام النظامية التي تقضي باستثناءات معينة تطبق خلال الفترة الانتقالية الناتجة عن إصدار أو تعديل أي من الأنظمة واللوائح أو التعليمات الضريبيّة أو الزكوية.
records.english_definition: A set of statutory provisions that provide specific exceptions that are applied during the transitional period resulting from the issuance or amendment of any of the laws, regulations, tax or zakat instructions.

translations.word: Transitional Rules|A set of statutory provisions that provide specific exceptions that are applied during the transitional period resulting from the issuance or amendment of any of the laws, regulations, tax or zakat instructions.

records.definition: سياسة تهدف إلى تقليل الاعتماد على الواردات من خلال تشجيع الإنتاج المحلي للسلع.
records.english_definition: A policy aimed at reducing dependency on imports by encouraging domestic production of goods.

translations.word: Import Substitution|A policy aimed at reducing dependency on imports by encouraging domestic production of goods.

records.definition: منهجية لاختبار البرمجيات تقوم على فحص البنية الداخلية للنظام وآليات عمله.
records.english_definition: A method of software testing examining internal structures and workings.

translations.word: White-Box Testing|A method of software testing examining internal structures and workings.

records.english_definition: A method of software testing examining functionality without looking at internal structures.

translations.word: Black-Box Testing|A method of software testing examining functionality without looking at internal structures.

variants.ambiguity_note: قد يقصد به الصندوق الأسود في الطائرات

records.definition: مزيج من اختبار الصندوق الأبيض واختبار الصندوق الأسود الذي يحدد العيوب بسبب الهيكل أو الاستخدام غير المناسب.
records.english_definition: Combines white-box and black-box testing, identifying defects due to improper structure or usage.

translations.word: Grey-Box Testing|Combines white-box and black-box testing, identifying defects due to improper structure or usage.

records.definition: وسيلة لاختبار المواقع الإلكترونية والتطبيقات أو أي منتج رقمي، من خلال مراقبة مستخدمين حقيقيين أثناء محاولتهم تنفيذ مهامّ معينة على تلك المنتجات.
records.english_definition: A method of testing websites, applications, or any digital product, by observing real users as they attempt to perform certain tasks on those products.

translations.word: Usability Testing|A method of testing websites, applications, or any digital product, by observing real users as they attempt to perform certain tasks on those products.

records.definition: سلطة المحكمة القانونية في النظر والفصل في القضايا ضمن نطاق جغرافيّ محدد، بما يشمل الحدود التنظيمية والقانونية التي تحكم عملها وأنظمتها.
records.english_definition: Legal authority of a court to hear and decide cases within a defined geographical area, including the organizational and legal boundaries that govern its operation and rules.

translations.word: Judicial Jurisdiction|Legal authority of a court to hear and decide cases within a defined geographical area, including the organizational and legal boundaries that govern its operation and rules.

records.definition: عدم التوافق بين حجم الإنتاج وحجم الاستهلاك مما يسبّب اضطرابًا في الأسعار أو الكميّات المتداولة في السوق.
records.english_definition: A market condition where supply and demand are not in equilibrium, causing price volatility.

translations.word: Supply-Demand Unequilibrium|A market condition where supply and demand are not in equilibrium, causing price volatility.

records.definition: انقطاعات في سلاسل التوريد تسبب التأخير والنقص وزيادة التكاليف.
records.english_definition: Disruptions in supply chains causing delays, shortages, and increased costs.

translations.word: Supply Chain Disruptions|Disruptions in supply chains causing delays, shortages, and increased costs.

records.definition: العملية الأخيرة التي تم تنفيذها على المطالبة الماليّة مثل التدقيق أو رفع شهادة الإنجاز.
records.english_definition: The last action performed on the financial claim since it was created, such as verification or submission of a completion certificate.

records.definition: مقياس لكفاءة الاقتصاد واستقراره ونموه بمرور الوقت.
records.english_definition: A measure of an economy’s efficiency, stability, and growth over time.

translations.word: Economic Performance|A measure of an economy’s efficiency, stability, and growth over time.

records.definition: مدى فاعلية الموظف وإنتاجيته في تنفيذ مهامّ الأعمال والمسؤوليات المسندة إليه.
records.english_definition: An employee's effectiveness and productivity in carrying out their work tasks and responsibilities.

translations.word: Job Performance|An employee's effectiveness and productivity in carrying out their work tasks and responsibilities.

records.definition: تقييم فعالية وكفاءة المؤسسات الاقتصادية المملوكة للقطاع الخاص في تحقيق الأهداف الاقتصادية مثل: الأرباح، والنمو، وخلق فرص العمل، ويشمل مؤشرات مثل: الكفاءة، والإنتاجيّة، ومعدلات النمو.

translations.word: Private Sector Performance|The assessment of the effectiveness and efficiency of privately owned economic institutions in achieving economic goals such as profits, growth, and job creation, including indicators such as efficiency, productivity, and growth rates.

records.definition: عقد أو التزام ماليّ ورقيّ أو إلكترونيّ يُستخدم بموجبه مديونية، أو يشكل إقرارًا بمديونية، وتكون تلك الأداة قابلة للتداول، تصدرها الشركات أو الحكومة، أو الهيئات العامة، أو المؤسسات العامة.
records.english_definition: Tradeable instrument creating or acknowledging indebtedness issued by companies, the government, public institutions or public organizations.

translations.word: Debt Instrument|Tradeable instrument creating or acknowledging indebtedness issued by companies, the government, public institutions or public organizations.

records.definition: عقد أو التزام ماليّ ورقيّ أو إلكترونيّ يُمنح لحامله الحق في تبديله بأسهم في شركة تملِك فيها الشركة المصدرة لتلك الأداة عددًا من الأسهم يساوي أو يزيد على عدد الأسهم التي يمكن التبديل إليها مقابل أداة الدَّين القابلة للتبديل.
records.english_definition: A debt instrument whose holder has the right to exchange it for shares in a company in which the issuer of that instrument owns a number of shares equal to or greater than the number of shares that can be exchanged for the exchangeable debt instrument.

translations.word: Exchangeable Debt Instrument|A debt instrument whose holder has the right to exchange it for shares in a company in which the issuer of that instrument owns a number of shares equal to or greater than the number of shares that can be exchanged for the exchangeable debt instrument.

records.definition: عقد أو التزام ماليّ ورقيّ أو إلكترونيّ  يُمنح لحامله الحق في تحويله لأسهم في الشركة المُصدرة لتلك الأداة.
records.english_definition: A debt instrument whose holder has the right to convert it into shares of the company issuing that instrument.

translations.word: Convertible Debt Instrument|A debt instrument whose holder has the right to convert it into shares of the company issuing that instrument.

records.definition: عقد أو التزام ماليّ ورقيّ أو إلكترونيّ صادر عن منشأة ذات أغراض خاصة يقضي  استحقاق حملة أداة الدَّين للعائد لا يعتمد على العوائد المحققة على أصول المنشأة ذات الأغراض الخاصة، وأن الراعي ملزم (سواءً بموجب ضمان أو غير ذلك) تجاه حملة أداة الدَّين بدفع المبالغ المستحقة لهم بموجب أداة الدَّين، وأن القيمة الاسمية لأداة الدَّين تُدفع لحملة أداة الدَّين بتاريخ استحقاق أداة الدَّين أو قبل ذلك.
records.english_definition: A debt instrument issued by a special purpose entity that provides that the holders of the debt instrument are entitled to returns that are not dependent on the returns earned on the assets of the special purpose entity, that the sponsor is obligated (whether by guarantee or otherwise) to the holders of the debt instrument to pay them amounts due under the debt instrument, and that the nominal value of the debt instrument is paid to the holders of the debt instrument on or before the maturity date of the debt instrument.

translations.word: Debt-Based Debt Instrument|A debt instrument issued by a special purpose entity that provides that the holders of the debt instrument are entitled to returns that are not dependent on the returns earned on the assets of the special purpose entity, that the sponsor is obligated (whether by guarantee or otherwise) to the holders of the debt instrument to pay them amounts due under the debt instrument, and that the nominal value of the debt instrument is paid to the holders of the debt instrument on or before the maturity date of the debt instrument.

records.definition: عقد أو التزام ماليّ ورقيّ أو إلكترونيّ صادر عن منشأة ذات أغراض خاصة يقضي استحقاق حملته  للعائد الذي يعتمد كليًّا على العوائد المحققة على أصول المنشأة ذات الأغراض الخاصة. وأن الراعي غير ملزم (سواءً بموجب ضمان أو غير ذلك) تجاه حملة أداة الدَّين بدفع أي مبالغ مستحقة لهم بموجب تلك الأداة.
records.english_definition: A debt instrument issued by a special purposes entity where the entitlement of holders of the debt instrument to a return is wholly dependent on the returns generated by the special purposes entity’s assets; and the sponsor is not obliged to the holders of the debt instrument (whether by guarantee or otherwise) to pay any amounts due on the debt instrument.

translations.word: Asset-Backed Debt Instrument|A debt instrument issued by a special purposes entity where the entitlement of holders of the debt instrument to a return is wholly dependent on the returns generated by the special purposes entity’s assets; and the sponsor is not obliged to the holders of the debt instrument (whether by guarantee or otherwise) to pay any amounts due on the debt instrument.

records.definition: عقد أو التزام ماليّ ورقيّ أو إلكترونيّ صادر عن منشأة ذات أغراض خاصة يقضي استحقاق حملته  للعائد الذي يُحدد بنسبة من العوائد المحققة على أصول المنشأة ذات الأغراض الخاصة، وأن الراعي ملزم (سواءً بموجب ضمان أو غير ذلك) تجاه حملة أداة الدَّين بدفع المبالغ المستحقة لهم بموجب تلك الأداة.
records.english_definition: A debt instrument issued by a special purpose entity that entitles the holders of the debt instrument to a return determined as a percentage of the returns earned on the assets of the special purpose entity, and that the sponsor is obligated (whether by guarantee or otherwise) to the holders of the debt instrument to pay them amounts due under the debt instrument.

translations.word: Asset-Linked Recourse Debt Instrument|A debt instrument issued by a special purpose entity that entitles the holders of the debt instrument to a return determined as a percentage of the returns earned on the assets of the special purpose entity, and that the sponsor is obligated (whether by guarantee or otherwise) to the holders of the debt instrument to pay them amounts due under the debt instrument.

records.english_definition: The process of identifying financial risks, assessing them, and implementing necessary measures to mitigate or reduce their impact.

records.english_definition: Activities or investments that produce earnings or revenue, contributing to an individual's or organization's financial well-being.

translations.word: Income Generation|Activities or investments that produce earnings or revenue, contributing to an individual's or organization's financial well-being.

records.english_definition: A set of tools and technologies designed to collect, process, and analyze data related to beneficiary interactions and behaviors.

translations.word: Customer Analytics Tools|A set of tools and technologies designed to collect, process, and analyze data related to beneficiary interactions and behaviors.

records.definition: مستند جمارك عالميّ يصدر وفقًأ لشروط اتفاقيّة الإدخال المؤقت واتفاقيّة إسطنبول، يشتمل على ضمان عالميّ ساري المفعول ويجوز استخدامه بدلًا من مستندات الجمارك الوطنية وكضمان للضرائب ورسوم الاستيراد لتغطية الإدخال المؤقت للبضائع وبضائع العبور، حسب مقتضى الحال. ويجوز قبوله للتحكم ولرقابة التصدير المؤقت وإعادة استيراد البضائع، ولكن في هذه الحالة لا يطبق الضمان العالميّ.
records.english_definition: An international customs document which, issued under the terms of the Temporary Admission (ATA) Convention and the Istanbul Convention, incorporates an internationally valid guarantee and may be used, in lieu of national customs documents and as security for import duties and taxes, to cover the temporary admission of goods and, where appropriate, the transit of goods. translations.word: Temporary Admission (ATA) Carnet|An international customs document which, issued under the terms of the Temporary Admission (ATA) Convention and the Istanbul Convention, incorporates an internationally valid guarantee and may be used, in lieu of national customs documents and as security for import duties and taxes, to cover the temporary admission of goods and, where appropriate, the transit of goods. variants.example: الـ dividend السنوي للشركة مرتفع جدًا.

records.english_definition: The financial results and profits reported by a company on a quarterly basis, typically provided to shareholders and investors.

translations.word: Retained Earnings|The portion of a company's profits that is retained and not distributed as dividends.

records.definition: نوع من دخل الأرباح الذي يُعامل معاملة ضريبيّة مفضلة، وغالبًا ما يكون خاضعًا لمعدل ضريبيّ أقل من الأرباح العادية.
records.english_definition: A type of dividend income that receives favorable tax treatment, often subject to a lower tax rate than ordinary dividends.

records.definition: زيادة في قيمة الأصول أو الاستثمار بمرور الوقت.

records.english_definition: A financial crisis that affects the entire banking system, often leading to widespread instability and the need for government intervention.

translations.word: Systemic Banking Crisis|A financial crisis that affects the entire banking system, often leading to widespread instability and the need for government intervention.

records.definition: الأساس المحاسبي الذي تُثبت بموجبه المعاملات والأحداث الأخرى عند حدوثها وليس عند تَسَلُّم أو دفع النقد أو الأموال المماثلة للنقد فحسب. ومن ثَمّ تُسجل المعاملات والأحداث في السجلات المحاسبية وتُثبت في القوائم الماليّة للفترات ذات العلاقة، وتتضمن العناصر التي تُثبت بموجب المحاسبة على أساس الاستحقاق، الأصول والالتزامات وصافي الأصول أو حقوق الملكية والإيرادات والمصروفات.
records.english_definition: A basis of accounting under which transactions and other events are recognized when they occur (and not only when cash or its equivalent is received or paid). Therefore, the transactions and events are recorded in the accounting records and recognized in the financial statements of the periods to which they relate. The elements recognized under accrual accounting are assets, liabilities, net assets/equity, revenue, and expenses.

translations.word: Accrual Basis of Accounting|A basis of accounting under which transactions and other events are recognized when they occur (and not only when cash or its equivalent is received or paid). Therefore, the transactions and events are recorded in the accounting records and recognized in the financial statements of the periods to which they relate. The elements recognized under accrual accounting are assets, liabilities, net assets/equity, revenue, and expenses.

records.definition: يعتمد حساب زكاة الشركات بشكل عام على المبادئ والمعايير المحاسبية العامة، حيث يمكن تطبيق المفاهيم الزكوية الشرعية على الشركات التي تعد القوائم الماليّة وفًقا للمبادئ المحاسبية المتبعة في المملكة العربية السعودية، مع التحقق من التزام المكلف بمعيار العرض والإفصاح، ودقة هذه الإقرارات.
records.english_definition: Corporate zakat calculations generally rely on general accounting principles and standards. Sharia-compliant zakat concepts can be applied to companies that prepare financial statements in accordance with the accounting principles followed in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, while ensuring that the taxpayer adheres to the presentation and disclosure standards and the accuracy of these statements.

translations.word: Basis of Zakat Calculation|Corporate zakat calculations generally rely on general accounting principles and standards. Sharia-compliant zakat concepts can be applied to companies that prepare financial statements in accordance with the accounting principles followed in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, while ensuring that the taxpayer adheres to the presentation and disclosure standards and the accuracy of these statements.

records.definition: أحداث أو إجراءات تحدث على أساس جدول أو روتين يوميّ، تُستخدم غالبًا في سياق المعاملات أو التقارير الماليّة اليوميّة.
records.english_definition: Actions or events that occur on a daily or routine schedule, often used in the context of daily financial transactions or reporting.

translations.word: Daily Basis|Actions or events that occur on a daily or routine schedule, often used in the context of daily financial transactions or reporting.

records.definition: أداة بحثية تُستخدم لجمع البيانات من المستفيدين والعملاء من خلال طرح مجموعة من الأسئلة لمعرفة آرائهم حول منتج أو خدمة محددة.
records.english_definition: A research tool used to collect data from beneficiaries or customers by asking a set of questions to understand their opinions and satisfaction with a specific service.

translations.word: Survey|A research tool used to collect data from beneficiaries or customers by asking a set of questions to understand their opinions and satisfaction with a specific service.

variants.example: أرسلنا استبانه لجمع آراء العملاء.

records.definition: الإنفاق على الأصول الرأسماليّة خلال فترة زمنية، وذلك لتحقيق صافي زيادة في رأس المال الحقيقي للاقتصاد السعودي، ويمكن أن يُنفَّذ هذا الاستثمار من قبل الأفراد أو الشركات، أو يُموَّل من جانب الحكومة
records.english_definition: Spending on capital assets over a period of time, in order to achieve a net increase in the real capital of the Saudi economy. The investment is either made by individuals or companies or financed by governments

translations.word: Investment|Spending on capital assets over a period of time, in order to achieve a net increase in the real capital of the Saudi economy. The investment is either made by individuals or companies or financed by governments

records.definition: توجيه مدخرات اقتصادٍ ما في إقليم جغرافيّ ما لتكوين أصول رأسماليّة حقيقية جديدة أو امتلاكها في اقتصاد المملكة في إقليم جغرافيّ بها.
records.english_definition: Directing the savings of an economy in a specific geographic region to the formation or acquisition of new real capital assets within the Kingdom's economy in a specific geographic region.

translations.word: Foreign Investment|Directing the savings of an economy in a specific geographic region to the formation or acquisition of new real capital assets within the Kingdom's economy in a specific geographic region.

records.definition: استثمار طويل الأمد واهتمام دائم لكيانات اقتصادية مقيمة في اقتصاد آخر غير الاقتصاد السعودي، وهذا يعني امتلاك المستثمر الأجنبي بشكل فردي  أو أن يمتلك مجموعة من المستثمرين الأجانب ما نسبته 10% أو أكثر من القوة التصويتية لحقوق المساهمين، مما يخول ممارسة نوع من السيطرة أو التأثير في عملية صنع القرار بما يخدم مصالح المستفيد، وبذلك توصف هذه العملية بأنها استثمار أجنبي مباشر.
records.english_definition: An investment that reflects a long-term relationship and continuous interest by economic entities resident in an economy other than the Saudi economy. This means that the foreign investor, individually or as part of a group of foreign investors, owns 10% or more of the voting power of the shareholders' rights, which entitles him to exercise some form of control or influence over the decision-making process in a way that serves his interests. This process is thus described as a foreign direct investment.

translations.word: Foreign Direct Investment (FDI)|An investment that reflects a long-term relationship and continuous interest by economic entities resident in an economy other than the Saudi economy. This means that the foreign investor, individually or as part of a group of foreign investors, owns 10% or more of the voting power of the shareholders' rights, which entitles him to exercise some form of control or influence over the decision-making process in a way that serves his interests. This process is thus described as a foreign direct investment.

records.definition: الاستثمار في أصول أخرى غير الأسهم أو السندات أو النقد التقليدي، مثل العقارات أو الأسهم الخاصة أو صناديق التحوط أو السلع أو المقتنيات.
records.english_definition: Investments in assets other than traditional stocks, bonds, or cash, such as real estate, private equity, hedge funds, commodities, or collectibles.

translations.word: Alternative Investment|Investments in assets other than traditional stocks, bonds, or cash, such as real estate, private equity, hedge funds, commodities, or collectibles.

records.definition: استثمارات صغيرة تهدف إلى تحقيق استثمارات ضخمة، وتستهدف معالجة المشاكل البيئية والاجتماعية.
records.english_definition: Investments aimed at generating social or environmental benefits alongside financial returns.

translations.word: Catalytic Investment|Investments aimed at generating social or environmental benefits alongside financial returns.

records.definition: الاستثمار في الشركات التي تتوافق مع القيم الأخلاقية والبيئية والاجتماعية.
records.english_definition: Investing in companies that align with ethical, environmental, or social values.

translations.word: Socially Responsible Investment (SRI)|Investing in companies that align with ethical, environmental, or social values.

records.definition: الاستثمارات ذات الأثر الاجتماعي والبيئي، تهدف إلى تحقيق عائدات ماليّة مجزية، بالتوازي مع إحداث تأثيرات إيجابية وملموسة على المجتمع والبيئة.
records.english_definition: Investments made with the intention to generate positive social or environmental impact alongside financial returns.

translations.word: Impact Investment|Investments made with the intention to generate positive social or environmental impact alongside financial returns.

records.definition: الأموال التي تخصصها الحكومة للاستثمار في المشاريع أو الصناعات أو الأصول التي قد تساهم في الازدهار الماليّ للدولة.
records.english_definition: Funds allocated by the government to invest in various projects, industries, or assets, which can contribute to the country's financial well-being.

translations.word: Government Investments|Funds allocated by the government to invest in various projects, industries, or assets, which can contribute to the country's financial well-being.

records.definition: عملية يتم من خلالها تحديد الإجراءات التي من شأنها تحسين الفرص، والحد من التهديدات التي قد تتعرض لها المنشأة؛ وذلك من خلال تجنب المخاطر، أو نقلها، أو قبولها.
records.english_definition: A process through which actions are identified to improve opportunities and mitigate threats to an organization. This is done by avoiding, transferring, or accepting risks.

translations.word: Risk Response|A process through which actions are identified to improve opportunities and mitigate threats to an organization. This is done by avoiding, transferring, or accepting risks.

records.definition: صفقة تتضمن بيعًا وشراءً لأسهم شركة مدرجة أسهمها في السوق من خلال تقديم عرض أو صفقة بيع وشراء خاصة.
records.english_definition: A transaction involving the sale and purchase of shares of a company whose shares are listed on the market through a special offer or sale and purchase deal.

translations.word: Private Transaction|A transaction involving the sale and purchase of shares of a company whose shares are listed on the market through a special offer or sale and purchase deal.

records.definition: الاستحواذ على شركة باستخدام كمية كبيرة من الأموال المقترضة، مع استخدام أصول الشركة المستهدفة في كثير من الأحيان كضمان.
records.english_definition: The acquisition of a company using a significant amount of borrowed funds, with the target company's assets often used as collateral.

translations.word: Leveraged Buyout (LBO)|The acquisition of a company using a significant amount of borrowed funds, with the target company's assets often used as collateral.

records.definition: عرض الشركة المدرجة أسهمًا جديدة على مساهمي شركة غير مدرجة بدلًا من أسهمهم؛ بحيث تمثل هذه الأسهم الجديدة أكثر من 50% من أسهم الشركة المدرجة المتمتعة بحق التصويت بعد عملية الاستحواذ.
records.english_definition: An arrangement where a listed company makes an offer of new shares in itself to the shareholders of an unlisted company in exchange for their shares and theses new shares will represent more than 50% of the listed company voting shares after the acquisition.

translations.word: Reverse Takeover|An arrangement where a listed company makes an offer of new shares in itself to the shareholders of an unlisted company in exchange for their shares and theses new shares will represent more than 50% of the listed company voting shares after the acquisition.

records.definition: قدرة المقترض، على إدارة وسداد التزامات الدَّين دون التسبب في عدم استقرار ماليّ أو تخلف عن السداد.
records.english_definition: The borrower's ability to manage and repay debt obligations without causing financial instability or default.

translations.word: Debt Sustainability|The borrower's ability to manage and repay debt obligations without causing financial instability or default.

records.definition: قدرة الدولة على الوفاء بالتزاماتها الماليّة وتوفير الموارد الكافية لتلبية تلك الالتزامات حال استحقاقها، وهو ما يتحقق من خلال سياسات رشيدة تهدف إلى تنويع الإيرادات ورفع كفاءة الإنفاق، والسيطرة على عجز الميزانية بما يقلل مستويات الزيادة في الدَّين العام وأعبائه.
records.english_definition: The state's ability to meet its financial obligations and provide sufficient resources to fulfill those commitments when they come due, which is achieved through sound policies aimed at diversifying revenues, improving expenditure efficiency, and controlling the budget deficit to reduce the levels of increase in public debt and its burdens.

translations.word: Fiscal Sustainability|The state's ability to meet its financial obligations and provide sufficient resources to fulfill those commitments when they come due, which is achieved through sound policies aimed at diversifying revenues, improving expenditure efficiency, and controlling the budget deficit to reduce the levels of increase in public debt and its burdens.

records.definition: قدرة القطاع على النمو بشكل مستمر دون استنفاد الموارد أو الإضرار بالاقتصاد.
records.english_definition: The ability of an industry to grow consistently without depleting resources or harming the economy.

translations.word: Sector Growth Sustainability|The ability of an industry to grow consistently without depleting resources or harming the economy.

records.definition: خطة تحدد كيفية إدارة  ديون المؤسسة وإعادة هيكلتها على مدى فترة متوسطة المدى.
records.english_definition: Outlines a plan for managing and structuring an organization's debt over a medium-term.

translations.word: Medium-Term Debt Strategy|Outlines a plan for managing and structuring an organization's debt over a medium-term.

records.definition: إستراتيجية تتبعها الشركات في الأسواق الحالية وتتنافس من خلالها على حصة السوق، مما يزيد من فرص  المنافسة الشديدة بينها.
records.english_definition: A strategy that operates in existing markets where companies compete for market share, leading to intense competition.

translations.word: Red Ocean Strategy|A strategy that operates in existing markets where companies compete for market share, leading to intense competition.

records.definition: إستراتيجية تركز على إنشاء أسواق جديدة بمنافسة محدودة أو معدومة.
records.english_definition: A strategy that focuses on creating new markets with little or no competition.

translations.word: Blue Ocean Strategy|A strategy that focuses on creating new markets with little or no competition.

records.definition: الخطة أو النهج الذي تعتمده المنظمات لضمان توافق جهود تجربة المستخدم مع أهداف العمل واحتياجات المستخدم، يتضمن ذلك تحديد رؤية واضحة لكيفية مساهمة تجربة المستخدم في النجاح الشامل للمنتج أو الخدمة أو النظام.
records.english_definition: The plan or approach that organizations adopt to ensure that their User Experience (UX) efforts align with business goals and user needs. It involves defining a clear vision for how the user experience will contribute to the overall success of a product, service, or system.

translations.word: User Experience (UX)  Strategy|The plan or approach that organizations adopt to ensure that their User Experience (UX) efforts align with business goals and user needs. It involves defining a clear vision for how the user experience will contribute to the overall success of a product, service, or system.

records.definition: خطة شاملة يتم تطويرها من قبل المركز لتعزيز وتحسين التجربة الشاملة، التي يتمتع بها المستفيدون خلال تفاعلاتهم مع المركز.
records.english_definition: A comprehensive plan developed by the organization to enhance and improve the overall experience of beneficiaries when interacting with the center.

translations.word: Customer Experience Strategy|A comprehensive plan developed by the organization to enhance and improve the overall experience of beneficiaries when interacting with the center.

records.definition: إعادة مبلغ الرسوم الجمركيّة بموجب الإجراء المقرر لاسترجاعها.
records.english_definition: An amount of import duties and taxes repaid under the drawback procedure.

translations.word: Customs Duty Refund|An amount of import duties and taxes repaid under the drawback procedure.

records.definition: الجهود الإستراتيجية التي تبذلها المنظمات لإعادة جذب واستعادة أعمال العملاء الذين قد توقفوا عن استخدام منتج أو خدمة أو أصبحوا غير نشطين.
records.english_definition: Strategic efforts by organizations to re-engage and regain customers who have stopped using a product or service or become inactive.

translations.word: Customer Win-Back|Strategic efforts by organizations to re-engage and regain customers who have stopped using a product or service or become inactive.

variants.example: استراتيجيتنا تركز على Win-Back العملاء المفقودين.

records.definition: إلغاء التخصيص وإعادته إلى الجهة المخولة.
records.english_definition: Cancelation of allocation and returning the same to the authorized entity.

translations.word: Reclamation|Cancelation of allocation and returning the same to the authorized entity.

records.definition: عملية إعادة شراء الأوراق الماليّة أو سحبها.
records.english_definition: The process of repurchasing or retiring financial securities.

translations.word: Redemption|The process of repurchasing or retiring financial securities.

records.definition: طلب للاسترداد يقدمه المكلف أو من ينوب عنه بوكالة رسمية، وتقوم هيئة الزكاة والضريبة والجمارك بدراســـة طلب المكلف والتحقق من وجود مبالغ مدفوعة زائدة من قبله، وإنهاء إجراءات رد تلك المبالغ خلال ثلاثين يومًا من تاريخ اسـتلام الهيئة للطلب.
records.english_definition: A refund request is submitted by the taxpayer or his representative with an official power of attorney. The Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority shall study the taxpayer’s request, verify the existence of excess amounts paid by him, and complete the procedures for refunding those amounts within thirty days from the date the Authority receives the request.

translations.word: Tax Refund|A refund request is submitted by the taxpayer or his representative with an official power of attorney. The Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority shall study the taxpayer’s request, verify the existence of excess amounts paid by him, and complete the procedures for refunding those amounts within thirty days from the date the Authority receives the request.

records.definition: عملية معالجة وحل شكاوى أو مشاكل المستفيدين لاستعادة رضاهم.
records.english_definition: The process of handling and resolving beneficiaries' complaints or problems to restore their satisfaction.

translations.word: Service Recovery|The process of handling and resolving beneficiaries' complaints or problems to restore their satisfaction.

records.definition: معالجة شكاوى المستفيدين أو مشاكلهم مع التعاطف معهم وتقديم حلول سريعة وفعّالة.
records.english_definition: Handling beneficiary complaints or issues with empathy, speed, and effective solutions.

translations.word: Customer-Centric Service Recovery|Handling beneficiary complaints or issues with empathy, speed, and effective solutions.

records.definition: خطط وأنشطة لاستعادة وظائف الأعمال المهمة بعد الهجمات أو التعطيلات الإلكترونية.
records.english_definition: Plans and activities to restore critical business functions following cyber-attacks or disruptions.

translations.word: Disaster Recovery|Plans and activities to restore critical business functions following cyber-attacks or disruptions.

variants.ambiguity_note: اختصار قد يدل على معانٍ أخرى

records.definition: فحص الائتمان من قبل المقرضين الذي قد يؤدي إلى خفض درجة الائتمان مؤقتًا.
records.english_definition: A credit check by lenders that can temporarily lower a credit score.

translations.word: Hard Credit Inquiry|A credit check by lenders that can temporarily lower a credit score.

records.definition: سيطرة الشركات والدول المتقدمة على البنية التحتيّة الرقميّة والبيانات والتقنية وهيمنتها عليها.
records.english_definition: The control and dominance of digital infrastructure, data, and technology by powerful corporations or nations.

translations.word: Digital Colonialism|The control and dominance of digital infrastructure, data, and technology by powerful corporations or nations.

records.definition: حالة يحقق فيها الاقتصاد نموًا اقتصاديًا مستمرًا نسبيًا، مع معدلات تضخم منخفضة ومستقرة، ومعدلات بطالة منخفضة نسبيًا، مما يسمح بتجنب التقلبات الحادة أو الارتفاعات غير المبررة في الأسعار أو البطالة. ويُقاسُ الاستقرار الاقتصاديّ من خلال مؤشرات مثل: معدل النمو الاقتصادي، ومؤشر التضخم، ومعدل البطالة.
records.english_definition: An economic condition characterized by relatively stable economic growth, with low and stable inflation rates, and relatively low unemployment rates, which helps avoid sharp fluctuations or unjustified increases in prices or unemployment. Economic stability is measured through indicators such as economic growth rate, inflation index, and unemployment rate.

translations.word: Economic Stability|An economic condition characterized by relatively stable economic growth, with low and stable inflation rates, and relatively low unemployment rates, which helps avoid sharp fluctuations or unjustified increases in prices or unemployment. Economic stability is measured through indicators such as economic growth rate, inflation index, and unemployment rate.

records.definition: مقياس لاستقرار البيئة السياسية والتنبؤ بها في بلد ما، الذي يمكن أن يؤثر في قرارات الاستثمار والماليّة.
records.english_definition: A measure of the stability and predictability of a country's political environment, which can impact investment and financial decisions.

translations.word: Political Stability|A measure of the stability and predictability of a country's political environment, which can impact investment and financial decisions.

records.definition: التخصيص المنتظم للمبلغ القابل للاستهلاك للأصل غير الملموس على مدى عمره الإنتاجيّ.
records.english_definition: The systematic allocation of the depreciable amount of an intangible asset over its useful life.

translations.word: Amortization|The systematic allocation of the depreciable amount of an intangible asset over its useful life.

variants.ambiguity_note: قد تعني إطفاء الحريق أو الأنوار

records.definition: استخدام السلع أو الموارد بشكل مباشر في الأنشطة الاقتصادية، سواء كان ذلك في الإنتاج أو الاستهلاك الشخصي.
records.english_definition: The process of using goods or resources directly in economic activities, either in production or personal consumption.

translations.word: Consumption|The process of using goods or resources directly in economic activities, either in production or personal consumption.

records.definition: مصطلح يستخدم لتحديد المكان الذي يتلقى فيه العميل ويستخدم فعليًّا مجموعة من الخدمات المقدمة له.
records.english_definition: A term used to determine the place where a customer receives and makes actual use of a supply of services provided to him.

translations.word: Consumption of Services|A term used to determine the place where a customer receives and makes actual use of a supply of services provided to him.

records.definition: هيكل سداد القرض حيث تُضافُ الفائدة غير المدفوعة إلى الرصيد الأساسيّ.
records.english_definition: A loan repayment structure where unpaid interest is added to the principal balance.

translations.word: Negative Amortization|A loan repayment structure where unpaid interest is added to the principal balance.

records.definition: الإحضار أو الإيعاز بإحضار أي بضائع إلى إقليم الجمارك.
records.english_definition: The act of bringing or causing any goods to be brought into a Customs territory.

translations.word: Import|The act of bringing or causing any goods to be brought into a Customs territory.

variants.ambiguity_note: قد تعني تزويد السلع محليًا وليس الاستيراد من الخارج

records.definition: دخول السلع من خارج إقليم دول مجلس التعاون الخليجي إلى أيّ دولة عضو بالمجلس وفقًا لأحكام الجمارك الموحدة.
records.english_definition: The entry of Goods into any member state from outside the GCC territory in accordance with the provisions of the Unified Common Customs Law.

translations.word: Import of Goods|The entry of Goods into any member state from outside the GCC territory in accordance with the provisions of the Unified Common Customs Law.

records.definition: دخول السلع الانتقائية إلى المملكة التي لن يتم وضعها لاحقًا تحت الوضع المعلّق للرسوم الجمركيّة، بالإضافة إلى التخليص الجمركيّ، والإفراج عنها؛ لأغراض الاستيراد في المملكة.
records.english_definition: The entry into Saudi Arabia of excise goods which are not subsequently placed under a custom suspension arrangement besides customs clearance and release of excise goods for import purposes in Saudi Arabia.

translations.word: Import of Excise Goods|The entry into Saudi Arabia of excise goods which are not subsequently placed under a custom suspension arrangement besides customs clearance and release of excise goods for import purposes in Saudi Arabia.

records.definition: قيام الشخص - الذي صدر بشأنه قرار أو حكم - بالتظلم أمام لجنة الفصل في المخالفات والمنازعات الضريبيّة، أو الجهة القضائيّة المختصة خلال المدة المحددة.
records.english_definition: The person against whom a decision or ruling has been issued must file a grievance before the Tax Violations and Disputes Resolution Committee or the competent judicial authority within the specified period.

translations.word: Appeal|The person against whom a decision or ruling has been issued must file a grievance before the Tax Violations and Disputes Resolution Committee or the competent judicial authority within the specified period.

records.definition: النسبة المئوية التي يحصل عليها المُقرض مقابل استخدام أمواله، وقد يكون المُقرض بنكًا أو شركة أو شخصًا طبيعيًّا.
records.english_definition: A percentage that represents the cost or return generated by a loan or certain saving instruments.

translations.word: Interest Rates|A percentage that represents the cost or return generated by a loan or certain saving instruments.

variants.example: البنك خفض معدل الفائدة للمؤسسة.

records.definition: سعر تقديري استرشادي يوضع بناءً على أسعار السوق.
records.english_definition: Estimated reference price that is established based on the market prices.

translations.word: Estimated Prices|Estimated reference price that is established based on the market prices.

records.definition: مقارنة معيارية لجميع المشاريع المماثلة لتحديد السعر السائد.
records.english_definition: Benchmarking of all similar projects to determine the prevailing price.

translations.word: Prevailing Prices|Benchmarking of all similar projects to determine the prevailing price.

records.definition: سعر نفط برنت الخام وهو تصنيف تداول رئيسي لنفط الخام الخفيف الحلو المستخدم باعتباره تصنيف تداول رئيسي لأسعار البترول العالميّة.
