translations.word: Beneficiary Acquisition Cost| A key metric that represents the average cost NCGR incurs to acquire a new beneficiary. It is calculated by dividing the total costs associated with acquiring beneficiaries by the number of new beneficiaries gained during a specific period.

records.definition: طريقة محاسبية شاملة تدمج كافة تكاليف التصنيع المباشرة وغير المباشرة في التكلفة الإجماليّة للمنتج.
records.english_definition: An accounting method that incorporates all direct and indirect manufacturing costs into the total cost of a product.

translations.word: Absorption Cost|An accounting method that incorporates all direct and indirect manufacturing costs into the total cost of a product.

records.definition: التكاليف المباشرة والمرتبطة بعملية إنتاج السلع أو الخدمات التي تبيعها الشركة، بما في ذلك المواد والعمالة.
records.english_definition: The direct costs of producing goods sold by a business, including materials and labor.

translations.word: Cost of Sold Goods|The direct costs of producing goods sold by a business, including materials and labor.

records.definition: معدل الفائدة أو التكلفة المتكبدة من المؤسسات الماليّة عند الحصول على الأموال، مثل: الودائع أو القروض أو السندات، التي تؤثر في أنشطة الإقراض والأنشطة الاستثمارية لديهم.
records.english_definition: The interest rate or cost incurred by financial institutions when acquiring funds, such as deposits, loans, or bonds, which influences their lending and investment activities.

translations.word: Financing Cost|The interest rate or cost incurred by financial institutions when acquiring funds, such as deposits, loans, or bonds, which influences their lending and investment activities.

records.definition: التكاليف بعد التعديل يطرح منها تكاليف العقود في منصة اعتماد والمنصرف خارج العقود والحجوزات والمصروفات غير المرحلة.
records.english_definition: Costs after adjustment in which contracts costs are subtracted in the Etimad platform and the disbursed amount (out of contracts allocations), reserved amounts, and non-carried forward expenses are also subtracted.

translations.word: Free Cost|Costs after adjustment in which contracts costs are subtracted in the Etimad platform and the disbursed amount (out of contracts allocations), reserved amounts, and non-carried forward expenses are also subtracted.

records.definition: تمثل ما تم اعتماده من تكاليف البرنامج أو المشروع غير السنوية في بداية البرنامج أو المشروع. وهي التكاليف المعتمدة للبرنامج أو المشروع بعد أي خفض أو زيادة عن طريق المناقلات أو التعزيزات.
records.english_definition: Represent the allocations that have been approved for nonannual program costs or project costs at the very beginning of the program or project. It is the approved costs for the program or project after any reduction or increase through reclassifications or reinforcements.

translations.word: Approved Cost|Represent the allocations that have been approved for nonannual program costs or project costs at the very beginning of the program or project. It is the approved costs for the program or project after any reduction or increase through reclassifications or reinforcements.

records.definition: المبلغ المستخدم كبديل عن تكلفة الاقتناء أو التكلفة المستهلكة في تاريخ معين.
records.english_definition: An amount used as a surrogate for acquisition cost or depreciated cost at a given date.

translations.word: Deemed Cost|An amount used as a surrogate for acquisition cost or depreciated cost at a given date.

records.definition: الباقي من التكاليف مطروحًا منه إجماليّ الاعتمادات للسنة الحالية.
records.english_definition: The remaining of the costs minus the total appropriations for the current year.

translations.word: Deferred Cost|The remaining of the costs minus the total appropriations for the current year.

records.definition: التكلفة الإضافية التي يتم تكبدها نتيجة إنتاج وحدة إضافية من سلعة أو خدمة.
records.english_definition: The additional cost incurred by producing one more unit of a good or service.

translations.word: Marginal Cost|The additional cost incurred by producing one more unit of a good or service.

records.definition: الإطار العام الذي يحدد طبيعة الاقتصاد الوطني وتنظيمه، ويشمل مجموعة العناصر والمكونات التي يتشكل منها، مثل: القطاعات الاقتصادية الرئيسية، والصناعات الفرعية، وتوزيع الناتج المحلي الإجماليّ بين هذه القطاعات.
records.english_definition: The general framework that defines the nature and organization of the national economy, and includes the set of elements and components that make it up, such as the main economic sectors, sub-industries, and the distribution of GDP among these sectors.

translations.word: Economic Composition|The general framework that defines the nature and organization of the national economy, and includes the set of elements and components that make it up, such as the main economic sectors, sub-industries, and the distribution of GDP among these sectors.

records.definition: التدفقات في الأصول الثابتة التي توضح حركة الأصول داخل وخارج المنشأة وتشمل الموجودات الثابتة التي تقتنيها المنشأة لاستخدامها في تحقيق أغراضها وليس بقصد بيعها أو إدخالها كمادة أولية في عملياتها الإنتاجيّة كالمباني السكنية وغير السكنية، ومعدات النقل والأثاث والآلات والمعدات.
records.english_definition: The flows in fixed assets that illustrate the movement of assets into and out of the establishment, and includes fixed assets that the establishment acquires for use in achieving its purposes and not for the purpose of selling them or introducing them as raw materials in its production operations, such as residential and non-residential buildings, transportation equipment, furniture, machinery and equipment)

translations.word: Gross Fixed Capital Formation|The flows in fixed assets that illustrate the movement of assets into and out of the establishment, and includes fixed assets that the establishment acquires for use in achieving its purposes and not for the purpose of selling them or introducing them as raw materials in its production operations, such as residential and non-residential buildings, transportation equipment, furniture, machinery and equipment)

records.definition: تمديد الجهة الحكوميّة لمدة العقد القائم بينها وبين المتعاقد.
records.english_definition: The government agency extends the term of the contract between it and the contractor.

translations.word: Extension of Contract|The government agency extends the term of the contract between it and the contractor.

records.definition: زيادة قدرة الأفراد والمجتمعات على المشاركة في الأنشطة الاقتصادية والاستفادة منها.

translations.word: Economic Empowerment|Increasing individuals’ or communities’ ability to participate in and benefit from economic activities.

records.definition: الموارد الماليّة المخصصة للعمليات التجارية أو المشاريع أو الاستثمارات.
records.english_definition: Financial resources provided for business operations, projects, or investments.

translations.word: Finance|Financial resources provided for business operations, projects, or investments.

records.definition: الاستثمارات الماليّة التي تهدف إلى دعم الاستدامة البيئية، مثل مشاريع الطاقة المتجددة أو التقنيات منخفضة الكربون.
records.english_definition: Financial investments that are aimed at supporting environmental sustainability, such as renewable energy projects or low-carbon technologies.

translations.word: Green finance|Financial investments that are aimed at supporting environmental sustainability, such as renewable energy projects or low-carbon technologies.

records.definition: جمع رأس المال عن طريق بيع أسهم شركة، بدلًا من الاقتراض، حيث يحصل المستثمرون في المقابل على حصص ملكية وأرباح محتملة.
records.english_definition: Raising capital by selling shares of a company, rather than taking on debt. Investors receive ownership stakes and potential profits in return.

translations.word: Financing by Equity|Raising capital by selling shares of a company, rather than taking on debt. Investors receive ownership stakes and potential profits in return.

records.definition: الطرق غير التقليدية لزيادة رأس المال أو التمويل، مثل التمويل الجماعي والاستثمار المغامر والأسهم الخاصة.

translations.word: Alternative Funding|Non-traditional methods of raising capital or financing, such as crowdfunding, venture capital, and private equity.

records.definition: طريقة تمويل لجمع رؤوس الأموال من مجموعة كبيرة من الأفراد، يتم ذلك عادةً عبر منصات رقمية متخصصة على الإنترنت.
records.english_definition: A financing method where funds are raised from many individuals, typically via online platforms.

translations.word: Crowdfunding|A financing method where funds are raised from many individuals, typically via online platforms.

records.definition: طرح أوراق ماليّة من خلال منصة تمويل جماعي بالأوراق الماليّة على مشتركي تلك المنصة، وذلك بواسطة مؤسسة سوق ماليّة مرخص لها في ممارسة أعمال الترتيب.

translations.word: Securities Crowdfunding|Offering securities through a securities crowdfunding platform to the subscribers of that platform, by a capital market institution authorized to carry out arranging activity.

records.definition: العلم الذي يدرس كيفية تأثير العوامل النفسية والتحيزات السلوكية على عمليات اتخاذ القرارات الماليّة والاستثمارية.
records.english_definition: A field of finance studying how psychological biases influence investment and financial decisions.

translations.word: Behavioral Finance|A field of finance studying how psychological biases influence investment and financial decisions.

records.english_definition: A blockchain-based financial system that operates without traditional banks or intermediaries.

translations.word: Decentralized Finance (DeFi)|A blockchain-based financial system that operates without traditional banks or intermediaries.

records.definition: الخدمات الماليّة المقدمة للأفراد ذوي الدخل المنخفض، أو أولئك الذين لا يستطيعون الوصول إلى الخدمات المصرفية التقليدية.
records.english_definition: Financial services provided to low-income individuals or those without access to traditional banking.

translations.word: Microfinance|Financial services provided to low-income individuals or those without access to traditional banking.

records.definition: مجال ماليّ يتضمن إنشاء أو راق ماليّة معقدة، وغالبًا ما تكون مدعومة بمجموعات من الأصول مثل الرهون العقاريّة أو القروض، ومصممة لتلبية تفضيلات المستثمرين وملفات المخاطر الخاصة بهم.
records.english_definition: A financial field that involves the creation of complex securities, often backed by pools of assets, such as mortgages or loans, and designed to meet specific investor preferences and risk profiles.

translations.word: Structured Finance|A financial field that involves the creation of complex securities, often backed by pools of assets, such as mortgages or loans, and designed to meet specific investor preferences and risk profiles.

records.definition: قدرة دولة أو شركة على إنتاج السلع والخدمات بكفاءة والمنافسة في الأسواق العالميّة.
records.english_definition: The ability of a country or business to produce goods and services efficiently and compete in global markets.

translations.word: Economic Competitiveness|The ability of a country or business to produce goods and services efficiently and compete in global markets.

records.definition: استخدام البيانات والنماذج للتنبؤ بالاتجاهات والأداء الاقتصادي المستقبلي.
records.english_definition: The use of data and models to predict future economic trends and performance.

translations.word: Economic Forecasting|The use of data and models to predict future economic trends and performance.

records.english_definition: A system’s ability to anticipate a user’s needs or actions and provide relevant feedback or suggestions before the user explicitly requests it.

records.definition: إجراء تمكين ودعم الشركاء المعينين لأداء الأنشطة القيمة لشركتك (على سبيل المثال: مشاركة الرابط، أو إجراء الإحالة، أو إتمام الصفقة).
records.english_definition: The process of enabling and mobilizing the partners you've recruited to perform valuable activities for your business (e.g. sharing a link, making a referral, or closing a deal.)

records.definition: سحب المشروع من المقاول واستكمال تنفيذه على حسابه.
records.english_term: Execute Works at the Contractor's Cost
records.english_definition: To withdraw and execute the works at the contractor's cost and expenses.

translations.word: Execute Works at the Contractor's Cost|To withdraw and execute the works at the contractor's cost and expenses.

records.definition: قدرة الأفراد على تحسين أو تغيير وضعهم الاقتصادي مقارنة بوالديهم.
records.english_definition: The ability of individuals to improve or change their economic status relative to their parents.

translations.word: Intergenerational Mobility|The ability of individuals to improve or change their economic status relative to their parents.

records.definition: التنمية التي تلبي احتياجات الحاضر دون أن تعرض قدرة الأجيال القادمة على تلبية احتياجاتها الخاصة للخطر.
records.english_definition: Development that meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.

translations.word: Sustainable Development|Development that meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.

records.definition: إستراتيجية إدارة المخاطر التي تعمل على توزيع الاستثمارات عبر أصول مختلفة لتقليل التعرض للمخاطر.
records.english_definition: A risk management strategy that spreads investments across different assets to reduce exposure to risk.

translations.word: Diversification|A risk management strategy that spreads investments across different assets to reduce exposure to risk.

records.definition: إستراتيجية تنموية تهدف إلى توسيع القاعدة الإنتاجيّة للاقتصاد الوطني، من خلال تطوير قطاعات اقتصادية جديدة ومتنوعة، وتقليل الاعتماد المفرط على قطاع واحد أو صناعة وحيدة.
records.english_definition: The expansion of an economy into various sectors to reduce dependence on a single industry.

translations.word: Economic Diversification|The expansion of an economy into various sectors to reduce dependence on a single industry.

records.definition: ممارسة توزيع الاستثمارات عبر فئات الأصول المختلفة لتقليل المخاطر.
records.english_definition: The practice of spreading investments across different asset classes to reduce risk.

translations.word: Portfolio Diversification|The practice of spreading investments across different asset classes to reduce risk.

records.definition: عملية تنويع المحفظة أو الأعمال من خلال الاستثمار أو تطوير الأصول أو المنتجات أو الأسواق ذات الخصائص أو ملفات المخاطر المختلفة.
records.english_definition: The process of diversifying a portfolio or business by investing in or developing assets, products, or markets with different characteristics or risk profiles.

translations.word: Structural Diversification|The process of diversifying a portfolio or business by investing in or developing assets, products, or markets with different characteristics or risk profiles.

records.definition: أي ظرف أو حدث قد يؤثر سلبًا على المؤسسة ورسالتها ووظائفها ومصداقيتها وسمعتها وأصولها.
records.english_definition: Any circumstance or event that could negatively impact an organization, its mission, functions, credibility, reputation, and assets.

translations.word: Threat|Any circumstance or event that could negatively impact an organization, its mission, functions, credibility, reputation, and assets.

records.definition: استيراد أو محاولة استيراد البضاعة بقصد الغش في الإيراد.
records.english_definition: The importation or attempted importation of goods with intent to defraud the revenue.

translations.word: Smuggling|The importation or attempted importation of goods with intent to defraud the revenue.

records.definition: القيـام بـأي أعمـال لغايـة التخلّـف عـن دفـع الضريبـة بشـكل كامـل أو جزئـي أو محاولـة اسـترداد الضريبـة المسـتحقة دون أسـباب محقّـة لذلـك، وبطريقـة مخالفـة للقانـون.
records.english_definition: All actions taken for the purpose of avoiding tax payments, in whole or in part, or performing actions that would unlawfully result in a tax refund.

translations.word: Tax Evasion|All actions taken for the purpose of avoiding tax payments, in whole or in part, or performing actions that would unlawfully result in a tax refund.

records.definition: تصرف يقوم بموجبه شخص ما بخداع أو محاولة خداع الجمارك، ومن ثَمَّ يتهرب أو يحاول التهرب بشكل كليّ أو جزئي من دفع الضرائب والرسوم أو من تطبيق الحظر والقيود المفروضة بموجب قانون الجمارك أو يحاول الحصول على أي مزايا بشكل يخالف قانون الجمارك وبذلك يرتكب جنحة جمركية.
records.english_definition: Any act by which a person deceives, or attempts to deceive, the Customs and thus evades, or attempts to evade, wholly or partly, the payment of duties and taxes or the application of prohibitions or restrictions laid down by Customs law or obtains, or attempts to obtain, any advantage contrary to Customs law, thereby committing a Customs offence.

translations.word: Customs Fraud|Any act by which a person deceives, or attempts to deceive, the Customs and thus evades, or attempts to evade, wholly or partly, the payment of duties and taxes or the application of prohibitions or restrictions laid down by Customs law or obtains, or attempts to obtain, any advantage contrary to Customs law, thereby committing a Customs offence.

records.definition: حالة يكون فيها العرض والطلب في الاقتصاد متوازنين، مما يؤدي إلى استقرار الأسعار.
records.english_definition: A state in which supply and demand in an economy are balanced, resulting in stable prices.

translations.word: Economic Equilibrium|A state in which supply and demand in an economy are balanced, resulting in stable prices.

records.definition: حالة الاستقرار التي تتساوى فيها أسعار التنفيذ للبند مع قيمته الفعلية العادلة.
records.english_definition: The execution price of an item represents the actual and fair value of it.

records.definition: اتفاق عام أو رأي مشترك بين الخبراء أو المحللين أو أصحاب المصلحة بشأن اتجاهات السوق أو التنبؤات أو القرارات الاستثمارية.

records.definition: إجماليّ الالتزامات الماليّة التي تقترضها الحكومة من جهات داخلية أو خارجية لتمويل العجز في الميزانية أو لتمويل مشاريع تنموية واستثمارية، على أن تُسدّد في المستقبل وفق آجال محددة وبشروط متفق عليها.
records.english_definition: The total financial obligations incurred by the government through borrowing from domestic or foreign entities to finance budget deficits or to fund development and investment projects, which are to be repaid in the future according to specific terms and conditions.

translations.word: Public Debt|The total financial obligations incurred by the government through borrowing from domestic or foreign entities to finance budget deficits or to fund development and investment projects, which are to be repaid in the future according to specific terms and conditions.

records.definition: نوع من الديون الذي له أولوية أعلى في السداد في حال حدوث تعثر للمقترض. ويُعَدُّ أقل مخاطرة من الديون الثانوية.
records.english_definition: A type of debt that has a higher priority for repayment in the event of a borrower's default. It is considered less risky than subordinated debt.

translations.word: Priority Debt|A type of debt that has a higher priority for repayment in the event of a borrower's default. It is considered less risky than subordinated debt.

records.definition: الالتزامات الماليّة للحكومة، غالبًا تكون على صيغة سندات.
records.english_definition: A government’s financial obligations, often in the form of bonds.

translations.word: Sovereign Debt|A government’s financial obligations, often in the form of bonds.

records.definition: عملية جمع وتحليل واستغلال البيانات والرؤى عن المستفيدين لاتخاذ قرارات مستنيرة، يشمل ذلك جمع معلومات من مصادر متنوعة لفهم سلوكيات المستفيدين وتفضيلاتهم واحتياجاتهم.
records.english_definition: The process of collecting, analyzing, and leveraging data and insights about beneficiaries to make informed business decisions. It involves gathering information from various sources to understand customer behaviors, preferences, and needs.

translations.word: Beneficiary Intelligence|The process of collecting, analyzing, and leveraging data and insights about beneficiaries to make informed business decisions. It involves gathering information from various sources to understand customer behaviors, preferences, and needs.

records.definition: كل ما يعطى للموظف مقابل عمله بموجب عقد عمل مكتوب، أو غير مكتوب بغض النظر عن نوع الأجر، أو طريقة أدائه، مضافًا إليه العلاوات الدورية.
records.english_definition: All that is given to an Employee in return for his/her work, under a written or unwritten work contract, regardless of it the type of remuneration or payment method, and in addition to periodic increments.

translations.word: Basic Salary|All that is given to an Employee in return for his/her work, under a written or unwritten work contract, regardless of it the type of remuneration or payment method, and in addition to periodic increments.

variants.ambiguity_note: كلمة عامة

records.definition: يمثل الموارد الماليّة أو الأصول أو الأموال المتاحة للأفراد أو الشركات أو الحكومات،التي يمكن استخدامها في الاستثمار أو العمليات على أنها احتياطيّ ماليّ.
records.english_definition: The financial resources, assets, or funds available to individuals, businesses, or governments, which can be used for investment, operations, or as a financial cushion.

translations.word: Capital|The financial resources, assets, or funds available to individuals, businesses, or governments, which can be used for investment, operations, or as a financial cushion.

records.definition: الحد الأدنى من رأس المال الذي يُطلب من المؤسسات الماليّة الاحتفاظ به من قبل الجهات التنظيمية لضمان الاستقرار وامتصاص الخسائر المحتملة.
records.english_definition: The minimum amount of capital that financial institutions are required to maintain by regulators to ensure stability and absorb potential losses.

translations.word: Regulatory Capital|The minimum amount of capital that financial institutions are required to maintain by regulators to ensure stability and absorb potential losses.

records.definition: القيمة الإجماليّة للأسهم المتداولة للشركة، التي تُحْتَسَب عن طريق ضرب سعر السهم في عدد الأسهم.
records.english_definition: The total value of a company's outstanding shares of stock, calculated by multiplying the share price by the number of shares.

translations.word: Market Capitalization (Market Cap)|The total value of a company's outstanding shares of stock, calculated by multiplying the share price by the number of shares.

variants.example: نظراً لارتفاع Market Cap، قررت الشركة الاندماج.

records.definition: الأموال المتاحة للعمليات اليوميّة للشركة، والمحسوبة باعتبارها أصولًا متداولة مطروحًا منها الالتزامات المتداولة.
records.english_definition: The capital or funds available for a business's day-to- day operations, calculated as current assets minus current liabilities.

translations.word: Working Capital|The capital or funds available for a business's day-to- day operations, calculated as current assets minus current liabilities.

variants.example: قيمة Working Capital للشركة سلبية هذا الربع.

records.definition: الاستثمار المبكر في شركات ذات إمكانات نمو عالية، غالبًا بواسطة مستثمرين أو شركات من القطاع الخاص.
records.english_definition: Investment in early-stage companies with high growth potential, typically provided by private investors or venture capital firms. These investments are often in exchange for equity or ownership stakes in the company.

translations.word: Venture Capital|Investment in early-stage companies with high growth potential, typically provided by private investors or venture capital firms. These investments are often in exchange for equity or ownership stakes in the company.

variants.example: تمتلك الشركة حصتها في صندوق VC.

records.definition: الشخص المسؤول عن رعاية المنشأة ذات الأغراض الخاصة وفقًا لأحكام القواعد المنظمة للمنشآت ذات الأغراض الخاصة.
records.english_definition: The person responsible for sponsoring the special purposes entity in accordance with the provisions of the Rules for Special Purposes Entities.

translations.word: Sponsor|The person responsible for sponsoring the special purposes entity in accordance with the provisions of the Rules for Special Purposes Entities.

variants.example: الـ Sponsor قدم دعمًا ماليًا للمشروع.

records.definition: الجهة أو الشخص الذي يقر استخدام الموارد الماليّة والبشرية في عملية تنفيذ المشروع.
records.english_definition: The entity or person who approves the use of the financial and human resources in the project implementation process.

translations.word: Project Sponsor|The entity or person who approves the use of the financial and human resources in the project implementation process.

variants.example: تم تعيين Project Sponsor من الإدارة العليا.

records.definition: استخدام رأس المال المقترض (الديون) لزيادة العائد على الاستثمار، ويشار إليه غالبًا بنسبة الدَّين إلى حقوق الملكية.
records.english_definition: The use of borrowed capital (debt) to amplify returns on investment, often referred to as the debt-to-equity ratio.

translations.word: Economic Leverage|The use of borrowed capital (debt) to amplify returns on investment, often referred to as the debt-to-equity ratio.

variants.example: الـ leverage في هذا الاستثمار كان ممتازًا.

records.definition: التقييم أو الرأي الذي تعبر عنه وكالة تصنيف الائتمان بشأن قدرة الائتمان والمخاطر المرتبطة بجهة أو أداة ماليّة.
records.english_definition: The assessment or view expressed by a credit rating agency about the creditworthiness and risk associated with an entity or financial instrument.

translations.word: Rating Opinion|The assessment or view expressed by a credit rating agency about the creditworthiness and risk associated with an entity or financial instrument.

records.definition: الربح الذي تجنيه شركة ما بعد خصم التكاليف المباشرة لإنتاج أو شراء السلع أو الخدمات، ويمثل الفرق بين الإيرادات وتكلفة السلع المباعة.
records.english_definition: The profit a company earns after deducting the direct costs of producing or purchasing goods or services, representing the difference between revenue and the cost of goods sold.

translations.word: Gross Profit|The profit a company earns after deducting the direct costs of producing or purchasing goods or services, representing the difference between revenue and the cost of goods sold.

records.definition: مقياس لربحية الشركة يُحسب بطرح النفقات التشغيلية من إجماليّ الربح، ويعكس الأرباح الناتجة عن الأنشطة التجارية الأساسيّة.
records.english_definition: A measure of a company's profitability calculated by subtracting operating expenses from gross profit, reflecting the earnings generated from core business activities.

translations.word: Operation Profit|A measure of a company's profitability calculated by subtracting operating expenses from gross profit, reflecting the earnings generated from core business activities.

records.definition: قرار من هيئة الزكاة والضريبة والجمارك يُفصح عن قبولها للإقرار، أو تعديله وفقًا للمعلومات المتوفرة، والإجراءات المعمول بها في الهيئة.
records.english_definition: A decision by the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority that discloses its acceptance of the declaration or its amendment according to the information available to it, and the applicable procedures in ZATCA.

translations.word: Zakat Assessment|A decision by the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority that discloses its acceptance of the declaration or its amendment according to the information available to it, and the applicable procedures in ZATCA.

records.definition: كافة التفاعلات والخطوات التي يمر بها المستفيد، بدءًا من الاستكشاف وحتى الحصول على الدعم أو الخدمة.
records.english_definition: All interactions and steps a beneficiary goes through, starting from the discovery stage up to receiving support or service.

translations.word: Beneficiary Journey|All interactions and steps a beneficiary goes through, starting from the discovery stage up to receiving support or service.

records.definition: سلسلة الإجراءات التي تتم على المطالبة من وقت تسجيلها على المنصة حتى الموافقة عليها أو رفضها.
records.english_definition: The series of actions that take place on the claim from the time it is registered on the platform until it is approved or rejected.

translations.word: Claim Journey|The series of actions that take place on the claim from the time it is registered on the platform until it is approved or rejected.

records.definition: سلسلة الإجراءات التي تتم على أمر الدفع من وقت تسجيله على المنصة حتى صرفه أو إلغائه.
records.english_definition: The series of actions that take place on the payment order from the time of being registered on the platform until being approved or rejected.

translations.word: Claim Journey of Payment Order|The series of actions that take place on the payment order from the time of being registered on the platform until being approved or rejected.

records.definition: سلسلة الإجراءات التي تتم على أمر الصرف من وقت تسجيله على المنصة حتى الموافقة عليه أو رفضه.
records.english_definition: The series of procedures that take place on a disbursement order from the time it is registered on the platform until it is approved or rejected.

translations.word: Claim Journey for Disbursement|The series of procedures that take place on a disbursement order from the time it is registered on the platform until it is approved or rejected.

records.definition: وثيقة تتحقق من دقة المعاملات الماليّة مثل شراء الأوراق الماليّة أو بيعها وتقديم الأدلة على التداول.
records.english_definition: A document that verifies the accuracy of a financial transaction, such as the purchase or sale of securities, providing evidence of the trade.

translations.word: Confirmation Letter|A document that verifies the accuracy of a financial transaction, such as the purchase or sale of securities, providing evidence of the trade.

records.definition: رسالة خطية تُرسل إلى المدين لطلب سداد الدَّين المستحق، وتحدد المبلغ المدين به وشروط الدَّين وعواقب التخلف عن السداد.
records.english_definition: A written communication sent to a debtor to request payment for an outstanding debt, outlining the amount owed, terms, and consequences of non- payment.

translations.word: Debt Collection Letter|A written communication sent to a debtor to request payment for an outstanding debt, outlining the amount owed, terms, and consequences of non- payment.

records.definition: وثيقة تحدد شروط وأحكام وجدول سداد الدَّين، وتشمل مبلغ الدَّين والفائدة وتواريخ السداد.
records.english_definition: A document that outlines the terms, conditions, and schedule for repaying a debt, including the amount, interest, and payment dates.

translations.word: Debt Service Letter|A document that outlines the terms, conditions, and schedule for repaying a debt, including the amount, interest, and payment dates.

records.definition: تمثيل مرئي للخطوات ونقاط الاتصال التي يمر بها المستفيد أثناء تفاعله مع المركز.
records.english_definition: A visual representation of the steps and touchpoints the customer goes through during their interaction with the brand.

translations.word: Beneficiary Journey Mapping |A visual representation of the steps and touchpoints the customer goes through during their interaction with the brand.

records.definition: رسم هندسي مساحي مبني على نظام إحداثيات وطني يبين موقع المنطقة والوحدات العقاريّة، وحدودها ومعالمها، وأرقامها، وأطوالها، ومساحتها.
records.english_definition: A survey drawing that is based on a national coordinates system detailing the location, boundaries, number, dimensions and area of a region or a real estate unit/s.

translations.word: Cadastral Drawing|A survey drawing that is based on a national coordinates system detailing the location, boundaries, number, dimensions and area of a region or a real estate unit/s.

records.definition: النفقات التي تؤدي إلى رفع قيمة الأصول الرأسماليّة وعمرها الإنتاجيّ (إن وجد).
records.english_definition: Expenses that lead to increasing the value of capital assets and extending their useful life, if applicable.

translations.word: Capitalization of Expenses|Expenses that lead to increasing the value of capital assets and extending their useful life, if applicable.

records.definition: المدفوعات المطلوبة مقابل الخدمات أو المعاملات أو استخدام منتجات ماليّة معينة، مثل رسوم صيانة الحساب أو رسوم الخدمات.
records.english_definition: Are charges or payments required for services, transactions, or the use of certain financial products, such as account maintenance fees or service charges.

translations.word: Fees|Are charges or payments required for services, transactions, or the use of certain financial products, such as account maintenance fees or service charges.

records.definition: الرسوم التي يفرضها مجلس الموانئ على السفن أو الشحنات التي تتأخر في الميناء لفترة تتجاوز مدة التخليص أو التسليم المسموح بها،  ولا تؤثر في قيمة البضائع، لكن أي تأخير ملموس في إنجاز الإجراءات الجمركيّة من شأنه أن يتسبب بأعباء إضافية على المستورد نظرًا لتراكم رسوم الأرضيات. ومن ثَمَّ فإن سرعة التخليص تساعد المستوردين وتؤدي إلى تفادي الازدحام في الميناء.
records.english_definition: The charges fixed by the Harbors Board on ships/cargo delayed in harbor in excess of the permissible clearance or delivery period. (it however, does not affect the value of the goods but any considerable delay in processing/completion of customs formalities is bound to cause additional burden on the importer by way of demurrage accumulation. Hence speedy clearance helps importers as well as avoid congestion in the wharf.

translations.word: Quay Port Fees|The charges fixed by the Harbors Board on ships/cargo delayed in harbor in excess of the permissible clearance or delivery period. (it however, does not affect the value of the goods but any considerable delay in processing/completion of customs formalities is bound to cause additional burden on the importer by way of demurrage accumulation. Hence speedy clearance helps importers as well as avoid congestion in the wharf.

records.definition: الرسوم الجمركيّة وجميع الرسوم الأخرى التي تُجبَى على استيراد البضائع أو تتعلق بها، ولكنها لا تشمل أي مصاريف تنحصر في مبلغ يعادل التكلفة التقريبية للخدمات المقدمة أو التي تحصلها الجمارك نيابة عن سلطة وطنية أخرى.
records.english_definition: Customs duties and all other duties, taxes or charges which are collected on or in connection with the importation of goods, but not including any charges which are limited in amount to the approximate cost of services rendered or collected by the Customs on behalf of another national authority.

translations.word: Import Duties and Taxes|Customs duties and all other duties, taxes or charges which are collected on or in connection with the importation of goods, but not including any charges which are limited in amount to the approximate cost of services rendered or collected by the Customs on behalf of another national authority.

records.definition: مصاريف (نسبة مئوية) تفرضها شركة الشحن حيث يتعين تحصيل أجور الشحن لما وراء البحار والمصاريف الأخرى.
records.english_definition: Collection fees (percentage) imposed by the shipping company, where overseas freight and other charges are to be collected.

translations.word: Collection Fees|Collection fees (percentage) imposed by the shipping company, where overseas freight and other charges are to be collected.

records.definition: رسوم يفرضها المقرضون مقابل معالجة طلب قرض جديد.
records.english_definition: A fee charged by lenders for processing a new loan application.

translations.word: Origination Fee|A fee charged by lenders for processing a new loan application.

records.definition: ضرائب أو رسوم تُفرض على البضائع المستوردة أو المصدّرة، مما قد يؤثر في التجارة الدولية والإيرادات الحكوميّة.
records.english_definition: Taxes or duties imposed on imported or exported goods, which can affect international trade and government revenue.

translations.word: Customs Duties|Taxes or duties imposed on imported or exported goods, which can affect international trade and government revenue.

variants.ambiguity_note: كلمة تعني أيضًا جهاز الجمارك

records.definition: إخطار من وكالة تصنيف الائتمان يشير إلى رصد تقييم الائتمان للتغييرات المحتملة، باستثناء اتخاذ القرار النهائي.
records.english_definition: A notice from a credit rating agency indicating that a credit rating is being monitored for potential changes, but a final decision has not yet been made.

translations.word: Credit Watch|A notice from a credit rating agency indicating that a credit rating is being monitored for potential changes, but a final decision has not yet been made.

records.definition: عملية مستمرة لتتبع تقدم الإجراءات التصحيحية، والإبلاغ عنها، ومراقبة حل الحادث.
records.english_definition: The ongoing process of tracking and reporting the progress of corrective actions and monitoring the incident's resolution.

translations.word: Incident Monitoring and Reporting|The ongoing process of tracking and reporting the progress of corrective actions and monitoring the incident's resolution.

records.definition: وحدات تمثل تقليل أو إزالة طن متري واحد من انبعاثات ثاني أكسيد الكربون من الغلاف الجوي للحد من الانبعاثات.
records.english_definition: Units representing the reduction or removal of one metric ton of carbon dioxide (CO2) from the atmosphere, used as a way to offset emissions.

translations.word: Carbon Credits|Units representing the reduction or removal of one metric ton of carbon dioxide (CO2) from the atmosphere, used as a way to offset emissions.

records.definition: إرادة الشركة أو المستثمر وأهليتهما على تحمل المخاطر أو الاستثمار.
records.english_definition: A company's or investor's willingness and capacity to take on risk or make investments.

translations.word: Willingness|A company's or investor's willingness and capacity to take on risk or make investments.

records.definition: زيادات في الأسعار أو أسعار الفائدة أو الضرائب أو التكاليف الأخرى ذات الصلة ما قد يؤثر في التخطيط الماليّ والعمليات.
records.english_definition: Increases in prices, interest rates, taxes, or other related costs, which can impact financial planning and operations.

translations.word: Raise the Price and Interest|Increases in prices, interest rates, taxes, or other related costs, which can impact financial planning and operations.

records.definition: الإجراءات التي تطبقها الجمارك لضمان الالتزام بقانون الجمارك.
records.english_definition: Procedures implemented by customs to ensure compliance with customs law.

translations.word: Customs Control|Procedures implemented by customs to ensure compliance with customs law.

records.definition: الممارسات التي تقوم بها الجهة لضمان تحقيق أهدافها الإستراتيجية والتشغيلية ودقة التقارير والالتزام بالأنظمة واللوائح.
records.english_definition: The mechanisms, rules, and procedures implemented by the entity to ensure achievement of its strategic and operational objectives, accuracy of reports, and compliance with rules and regulations.

translations.word: Internal Control|The mechanisms, rules, and procedures implemented by the entity to ensure achievement of its strategic and operational objectives, accuracy of reports, and compliance with rules and regulations.

records.definition: أسلوب رقابيّ تكون فيه الجهة مسؤولة عن الرقابة على عملياتها ذات الأثر الماليّ من خلال منسوبيها ووفقًا لإجراءات رقابيّة داخلية يتم تقييمها واعتمادها من الوزارة.
records.english_definition: Transferring part or all of the supervisory responsibility from the financial controller to the government entity after achieving the necessary controls.

translations.word: Self-control|Transferring part or all of the supervisory responsibility from the financial controller to the government entity after achieving the necessary controls.

records.definition: مراجعة واعتماد مستندات العملية الماليّة قبل الصرف.
records.english_definition: Review and approving the financial transaction documents before disbursement.

translations.word: Prior Payment Control|Review and approving the financial transaction documents before disbursement.

records.definition: السياسات والإجراءات والوسائل التي يتم من خلالها مراقبة وضبط العمليات ذات الأثر الماليّ والتحقق من دقة وكفاءة وفاعلية أنظمة الرقابة الداخلية، ومدى التزام الجهة بالأنظمة واللوائح والأدلة والتعليمات والقرارات ذات الصلة.
records.english_definition: Policies, procedures and means by which operations with financial impact, are monitored and controlled, also to make sure that the internal control systems are working with the highest degree of accuracy, efficiency and effectiveness, in addition to checking the entity’s compliance with the relevant laws, regulations, manuals, instructions and decisions.

translations.word: Financial Control|Policies, procedures and means by which operations with financial impact, are monitored and controlled, also to make sure that the internal control systems are working with the highest degree of accuracy, efficiency and effectiveness, in addition to checking the entity’s compliance with the relevant laws, regulations, manuals, instructions and decisions.

records.definition: أسلوب إداري تتولى فيه الوزارة تطبيق الرقابة الماليّة داخل الجهة، من خلال المراقب الماليّ.
records.english_definition: An administrative method in which the Ministry implements financial control within the entity, through the financial controller.

translations.word: Direct Control|An administrative method in which the Ministry implements financial control within the entity, through the financial controller.

records.definition: أسلوب إداري تتولى الوزارة المتابعة المستمرة على أنظمة المعلومات ذات الأثر الماليّ من خلال تقييم تلك الأنظمة وتحليل بياناتها والتأكد من كفاءة وسلامة الضوابط الرقابيّة على عمليات التشغيل ومدخلات ومخرجات تلك الأنظمة.
records.english_definition: The Ministry's ongoing oversight of information systems with financial impact by evaluating these systems, analyzing their data, and ensuring the efficiency and integrity of regulatory controls over the operating processes and inputs and outputs of these systems.

translations.word: Central Control|The Ministry's ongoing oversight of information systems with financial impact by evaluating these systems, analyzing their data, and ensuring the efficiency and integrity of regulatory controls over the operating processes and inputs and outputs of these systems.

records.definition: رقم الإيراد، النفقة، البرنامج أو المشروع والموجود في تبليغ الميزانية وذلك بناء على تصنيف دليل إحصاءات ماليّة الحكومة.
records.english_definition: The revenue, expenditure, program or project number found in the budget report, based on the Government Finance Statistics Manual classification.

translations.word: Item Number|The revenue, expenditure, program or project number found in the budget report, based on the Government Finance Statistics Manual classification.

records.definition: مُعرف فريد مخصص للأوراق الماليّة يساعد المستثمرين والجهات التنظيمية في تتبع الأدوات الماليّة وتداولها.
records.english_definition: A unique identifier assigned to securities, helping investors and regulators track and trade financial instruments.

translations.word: International Securities Identification Number (ISIN)|A unique identifier assigned to securities, helping investors and regulators track and trade financial instruments.

variants.example: يجب التحقق من صحة الرقم ISIN قبل البيع.

records.definition: رقم التصنيف الاقتصادي.

records.english_definition: A method used by the Zakat, Tax, and Customs Authority (ZATCA) in calculating zakat on a zakat payer who does maintain commercial books and statutory accounts. records.definition: أداة دين تنشأ بموجبها مديونية تشكل إقرارًا بمديونية تصدرها شركات أو حكومات أو مؤسسات عامة ينتج عنها مدفوعات فوائد أو مدفوعات مماثلة لحامل الورقة الماليّة للديون حتى تاريخ الاستحقاق، وسداد المبلغ الأصلي - القيمة الاسمية للورقة الماليّة للديون - في تاريخ الاستحقاق من قبل جهة الإصدار، يمكن تداول الأوراق الماليّة للديون، بما في ذلك الحق في الاستفادة من الفوائد. هناك أشكال عديدة من الأوراق الماليّة للديون، مثل: سندات الشركات، والسندات الحكوميّة، والسندات المضمونة، وشهادات الإيداع، والسندات غير المضمونة.
records.english_definition: A loan, debt or any other financial instrument issued by companies or governments resulting in interest or similar payments to the holder of the debt security until the maturity date and repayment of the principal – the face value of the debt security at the maturity date made by the issuer. Debt securities, including the entitlement to interest benefits, can be traded. There are many forms of debt securities, such as corporate bonds, government bonds, collateralized bonds, certificates of deposit and debenture.

translations.word: Debt Securities|A loan, debt or any other financial instrument issued by companies or governments resulting in interest or similar payments to the holder of the debt security until the maturity date and repayment of the principal – the face value of the debt security at the maturity date made by the issuer. Debt securities, including the entitlement to interest benefits, can be traded. There are many forms of debt securities, such as corporate bonds, government bonds, collateralized bonds, certificates of deposit and debenture.

records.definition: نوع من السندات الحكوميّة التي تصدر عادة لأغراض معينة، مثل مشاريع البنية التحتية أو التنمية الاقتصادية.
records.english_definition: A type of government bonds often issued for specific purposes, such as infrastructure projects oreconomic development.

translations.word: Special Bonds (BOSP)|A type of government bonds often issued for specific purposes, such as infrastructure projects oreconomic development.

records.definition: نوع من العقود يستخدم لتمويل المشروعات الصديقة للبيئة وتلتزم جهة الإصدار باستخدام عائدات السند في المشاريع ذات الآثار البيئية الإيجابية.
records.english_definition: A type of bond used to finance environmentally friendly projects. The issuer commits to using the bond proceeds for projects with positive environmental impacts.

translations.word: Green Bond|A type of bond used to finance environmentally friendly projects. The issuer commits to using the bond proceeds for projects with positive environmental impacts.

records.definition: عقد ذو مخاطر تخلف عن السداد منخفضة نسبيًا، ويُصَنَّفُ عادةً على أنه BBB أو أعلى من قبل وكالات التصنيف الائتماني.
records.english_definition: A bond with a relatively low risk of default, typically rated BBB or higher by credit rating agencies.

translations.word: Investment-Rated Bonds|A bond with a relatively low risk of default, typically rated BBB or higher by credit rating agencies.

records.definition: عقد ذو مخاطر عالية للتخلف عن السداد وتصنيف ائتماني منخفض، وغالبًا ما يقدم عوائد عالية للتعويض عن المخاطر.
records.english_definition: A bond with a high risk of default and a low credit rating, often offering high returns to compensate for the risk.

translations.word: High-Risk Bonds|A bond with a high risk of default and a low credit rating, often offering high returns to compensate for the risk.

records.definition: عقد تُعَدَّل فيه مدفوعات الفائدة ورأس المال على أساس التضخم؛ مما يحمي المستثمرين من مخاطر التضخم.
records.english_definition: A bond whose interest payments and principal are adjusted based on inflation, protecting investors from inflation risk.

translations.word: Inflation Related Bonds|A bond whose interest payments and principal are adjusted based on inflation, protecting investors from inflation risk.

records.definition: سهم أي شركة أينما كان مقرّ تأسيسها. ويشمل تعريف "سهم" كل أداة تكون لها خصائص رأس المال.
records.english_definition: Share of any company wherever incorporated. The definition of “share” includes every instrument having the characteristics of equity.

translations.word: Share|Share of any company wherever incorporated. The definition of “share” includes every instrument having the characteristics of equity.

records.definition: مدى قدرة المستخدمين على التفاعل بفعالية وكفاءة مع منتج أو نظام أو خدمة لتحقيق أهدافهم المقصودة. إنها جانب أساسيّ من تصميم تجربة المستخدم، حيث تركز على مدى سهولة استخدام التصميم وقابليته للوصول إليه.
records.english_definition: Usability refers to the ease with which users can effectively and efficiently interact with a product, system, or service to achieve their intended goals. It is a fundamental aspect of user experience (UX) design, emphasizing how user-friendly and accessible a design is.

translations.word: Usability|Usability refers to the ease with which users can effectively and efficiently interact with a product, system, or service to achieve their intended goals. It is a fundamental aspect of user experience (UX) design, emphasizing how user-friendly and accessible a design is.

records.definition: الصناعة العالميّة التي تؤثر في إنتاج البترول وتسعيره وتوزيعه.
records.english_definition: The worldwide industry that influences oil production, pricing, and distribution.

translations.word: Global Oil Markets|The worldwide industry that influences oil production, pricing, and distribution.

records.definition: سوق التداول الأساسيّ أو نظام التداول البديل؛ وتشمل أي لجنة، أو لجنة فرعية، أو موظف، أو مسؤول، أو تابع، أو وكيل يمكن أن يكلّف في الوقت الحاضر بالقيام بأي من وظائف السوق. وعبارة "في السوق" تعني أي نشاط يتم من خلال التجهيزات التي يوفرها السوق أو بواسطتها.
records.english_definition: The Primary Exchange or Alternative Trading System including where the context permits any committee, sub-committee, employee, officer, affiliate or agent to whom any function of the Exchange may for the time being be delegated, and "on Exchange" means any activity taking place through or by the facilities provided by the Exchange.

translations.word: Exchange Market|The Primary Exchange or Alternative Trading System including where the context permits any committee, sub-committee, employee, officer, affiliate or agent to whom any function of the Exchange may for the time being be delegated, and "on Exchange" means any activity taking place through or by the facilities provided by the Exchange.

records.definition: سوق تُتَداول فيها المواد الخام مثل: النفط، والذهب، والمنتجات الزراعية.
records.english_definition: A marketplace where raw materials like oil, gold, and agricultural products are traded.

translations.word: Commodities Market|A marketplace where raw materials like oil, gold, and agricultural products are traded.

records.definition: السوق الماليّ التي تُتَداولُ فيها أدوات الدَّين، وهي الأوراق الماليّة التي تمثل التزامات دين على المصدر، سواء كان حكومة أو شركة أو مؤسسة ماليّة.
records.english_definition: A financial market where investors trade debt securities issued by governments and corporations.

translations.word: Bond Market|A financial market where investors trade debt securities issued by governments and corporations.

records.definition: السوق التي يجري فيها شراء الأوراق الماليّة الجديدة وبيعها، مثل الأسهم والسندات، لأول مرة، وعادةً ما يحدث ذلك من خلال الطروحات العامة الأولية أو عمليات إصدار السندات.
records.english_definition: The market where newly issued securities, such as stocks and bonds, are bought and sold for the first time, typically through initial public offerings (IPOs) or bond issuances.

translations.word: Primary Market|The market where newly issued securities, such as stocks and bonds, are bought and sold for the first time, typically through initial public offerings (IPOs) or bond issuances.

records.definition: سوق ماليّة تشترى فيها وتباع الأوراق الماليّة القائمة، مثل: الأسهم، والسندات، والمشتقات الماليّة بين المستثمرين بدلًا من كونها مباشرة من جهة الإصدار.
records.english_definition: A financial market where existing securities, such as stocks, bonds, or derivatives, are bought and sold among investors, rather than directly from the issuer.

translations.word: Secondary Market|A financial market where existing securities, such as stocks, bonds, or derivatives, are bought and sold among investors, rather than directly from the issuer.

records.definition: البناء أو المكان المرخص له الذي تودع فيه البضائع في وضع معلق للرسوم الجمركيّة لغايات العرض والبيع.
records.english_definition: The licensed building or place wherein goods are placed free of customs duties for purposes of display or sale.

translations.word: Duty-Free Market|The licensed building or place wherein goods are placed free of customs duties for purposes of display or sale.

records.definition: سوق ماليّة تخدم الجهات التي تحتاج إلى تمويل طويل الأجل مثل الأسهم والسندات.
records.english_definition: A financial market for buying and selling long-term securities like stocks and bonds.

translations.word: Capital Market|A financial market for buying and selling long-term securities like stocks and bonds.

records.definition: السوق التي تُتَداول فيها الأسهم التي تم تسجيلها وطرحها بموجب الباب الرابع من قواعد طرح الأوراق الماليّة والالتزامات المستمرة.
records.english_definition: The market in which shares registered and offered under Part 4 of the Rules on the Offering of Securities and Continuing Obligations are traded.

translations.word: Main Market|The market in which shares registered and offered under Part 4 of the Rules on the Offering of Securities and Continuing Obligations are traded.

records.definition: السوق العالميّة حيث تُتَداول العملات.
records.english_definition: The global marketplace where currencies are traded.

translations.word: Foreign Exchange Market|The global marketplace where currencies are traded.

records.definition: الأنظمة الماليّة والتجارية الدولية التي يتم فيها تبادل السلع والخدمات والاستثمارات.
records.english_definition: International financial and trade systems where goods, services, and investments are exchanged.

translations.word: Global Markets|International financial and trade systems where goods, services, and investments are exchanged.

records.definition: سوق تُشترى فيها وتباع الموارد الإنتاجيّة (الأرض، والعمالة، ورأس المال، وريادة الأعمال)، حيث تشتري الشركات العمالة من العمال، ورأس المال من المستثمرين، وهكذا.
records.english_definition: A market where productive resources (land, labor, capital, and entrepreneurship) are bought and sold. Businesses purchase labor from workers, capital from investors, etc.

translations.word: Production Factors Market|A market where productive resources (land, labor, capital, and entrepreneurship) are bought and sold. Businesses purchase labor from workers, capital from investors, etc.

records.definition: السوق التي تُتداول فيها الأسهم التي تم تسجيلها وطرحها بموجب الباب الثامن من قواعد طرح الأوراق الماليّة والالتزامات المستمرة.
records.english_definition: The market of Exchange where shares, that have been registered and offered pursuant to Part 8 of the Rules on the Offer of Securities and Continuing Obligations, are traded.

translations.word: Parallel Market|The market of Exchange where shares, that have been registered and offered pursuant to Part 8 of the Rules on the Offer of Securities and Continuing Obligations, are traded.

variants.ambiguity_note: كلمة عامة تعني الزيادة والتطور

records.definition: سوق تُحدد فيها أسعار الصكوك الماليّة بصورةٍ رئيسية من خلال عروض الأسعار أو العطاءات من صناع السوق أو التجار.
records.english_definition: A market structure where prices for financial instruments are primarily determined by quotes or bids from market makers or dealers.

translations.word: Quote Driven Market|A market structure where prices for financial instruments are primarily determined by quotes or bids from market makers or dealers.

records.definition: الاقتصادات التي تكون في مرحلة انتقالية من حالة النمو إلى حالة التقدم، وتتميز بالنمو السريع، والتصنيع المتزايد، وتحرير الأسواق.
records.english_definition: Economies in transition from developing to developed status, characterized by rapid growth, increasing industrialization, and market liberalization.

translations.word: Emerging Market|Economies in transition from developing to developed status, characterized by rapid growth, increasing industrialization, and market liberalization.

records.definition: العلاقات أو المعاملات أو الاتفاقيات التي تنطوي على دول سيادية متعددة، في سياق التجارة الدولية أو التعاون الدبلوماسيّ أو الماليّ.
records.english_definition: Relationships, transactions, or agreements that involve multiple sovereign states, often in the context of international trade, diplomacy, or financial cooperation.

translations.word: Multi-Entity Sovereignties|Relationships, transactions, or agreements that involve multiple sovereign states, often in the context of international trade, diplomacy, or financial cooperation.

records.definition: سياسة نقديّة يحدد فيها البنك المركزي سعر الفائدة الاسمي عند الصفر أو بالقرب منه، وعادةً ما تُستخدم لتحفيز النشاط الاقتصادي خلال فترات التضخم المنخفض أو الركود.
records.english_definition: A monetary policy in which the central bank sets the nominal interest rate at or near zero, typically used to stimulate economic activity during periods of low inflation or recession.

translations.word: Zero Interest Rate Policy|A monetary policy in which the central bank sets the nominal interest rate at or near zero, typically used to stimulate economic activity during periods of low inflation or recession.

records.definition: المنهجية التي يتبعها الأطراف المرتبطون عند تحديدهم لأسعار سلع أو خدمات.
records.english_definition: The methodology followed by related parties when setting prices for goods or services.

translations.word: Transfer Pricing Policy|The methodology followed by related parties when setting prices for goods or services.

records.definition: قرارات الحكومة بشأن الضرائب والإنفاق للتأثير في الاقتصاد، مثل زيادة الإنفاق لتعزيز النمو أو رفع الضرائب للسيطرة على التضخم.
records.english_definition: Government decisions on taxation and spending to influence the economy, such as increasing spending to boost growth or raising taxes to control inflation.

translations.word: Fiscal Policy|Government decisions on taxation and spending to influence the economy, such as increasing spending to boost growth or raising taxes to control inflation.

records.definition: سياسة تهدف إلى خفض الإنفاق الحكوميّ أو زيادة الضرائب لإبطاء وتيرة النشاط الاقتصادي وخفض التضخم.
records.english_definition: A policy aimed at reducing government spending or increasing taxes to slow down the economy and reduce inflation.

translations.word: Contractionary Fiscal Policy|A policy aimed at reducing government spending or increasing taxes to slow down the economy and reduce inflation.

records.definition: العملية التي يستخدمها البنك المركزي لإدارة المعروض النقديّ وأسعار الفائدة للتأثير في النمو الاقتصادي.
records.english_definition: The process by which a central bank manages money supply and interest rates to influence economic growth.

translations.word: Monetary Policy|The process by which a central bank manages money supply and interest rates to influence economic growth.

records.definition: سياسة تهدف إلى زيادة المعروض النقديّ وخفض أسعار الفائدة لتحفيز النمو الاقتصادي.
records.english_definition: A policy aimed at increasing the money supply and reducing interest rates to stimulate economic growth.

translations.word: Expansionary Monetary Policy|A policy aimed at increasing the money supply and reducing interest rates to stimulate economic growth.

records.definition: تسلسل محدد من المهامّ أو العمليات أو الخطوات التي يتعين إكمالها بترتيب معين لتحقيق هدف أو نتيجة معينة.
records.english_definition: A defined sequence of tasks, processes, or steps that need to be completed in a specific order to achieve a particular goal or outcome.

translations.word: Workflow|A defined sequence of tasks, processes, or steps that need to be completed in a specific order to achieve a particular goal or outcome.

records.definition: يُقصد به في لائحة الاندماج والاستحواذ: القدرة على التأثير في أفعال شخص آخر أو قراراته بشكل مباشر أو غير مباشر (باستثناء الملكية غير المباشرة عن طريق اتفاقيّة المبادلة أو عن طريق صندوق استثماري لا يكون لمالك وحداته أي حق في قرارات استثماره)، منفردًا أو مجتمعًا مع شخص أو أشخاص يتصرفون معه بالاتفاق، من خلال امتلاك (بشكل مباشر أو غير مباشر) نسبة تساوي 30% أو أكثر من حقوق التصويت في شركة، ويفسَّر مصطلح "المسيطر" وفقًا لذلك.
records.english_definition: In the Merger & Acquisition regulations, in the ability to influence the actions or decisions of another person, whether directly or indirectly (excluding indirect ownership of shares through swap arrangements or through an investment fund whose unit owner have no discretion in its investment decisions), individually or collectively with a person or persons acting in concert, through holding (directly or indirectly) 30% or more of the voting rights in a company. moreover, “controller” shall be construed accordingly.

translations.word: Control|In the Merger & Acquisition regulations, in the ability to influence the actions or decisions of another person, whether directly or indirectly (excluding indirect ownership of shares through swap arrangements or through an investment fund whose unit owner have no discretion in its investment decisions), individually or collectively with a person or persons acting in concert, through holding (directly or indirectly) 30% or more of the voting rights in a company. moreover, “controller” shall be construed accordingly.

records.definition: خطة ماليّة يجب أن يكون فيها إجماليّ الاعتمادات المطلوبة للعام القادم في النماذج بحيث لا يتجاوز قيمة السقف المبدئي للمبلغ المخصص للجهة، على أن يتضمن النفقات الحتمية للجهة.
records.english_definition: A financial plan in which the total appropriations requested for the next year in the forms must not exceed the initial ceiling value of the amount allocated to the entity, provided that it includes the entity’s inevitable expenses.

translations.word: Budget Scenario by Ceiling|A financial plan in which the total appropriations requested for the next year in the forms must not exceed the initial ceiling value of the amount allocated to the entity, provided that it includes the entity’s inevitable expenses.

records.definition: خطة ماليّة قد تكون فيها الاعتمادات المطلوبة للعام القادم في النماذج أعلى أو أقل من السقف المبدئي ووفق ما تراه الجهة.
records.english_definition: A financial plan in which the credits required for the next year in the forms may be higher or lower than the initial ceiling, as determined by the entity.

translations.word: Customized Budget Scenario|A financial plan in which the credits required for the next year in the forms may be higher or lower than the initial ceiling, as determined by the entity.

records.definition: سهولة وسرعة تحويل أصل أو ورقة ماليّة إلى نقديّة دون خسارة كبيرة في القيمة.
records.english_definition: The ease and speed with which an asset or security can be converted into cash without a significant loss of value.

translations.word: Liquidity|The ease and speed with which an asset or security can be converted into cash without a significant loss of value.

variants.ambiguity_note: كلمة عامية تعني النقد عمومًا

records.definition: مدة توافر الأموال الحكوميّة أو الموارد الماليّة التي يمكن تخصيصها بسهولة أو استخدامها لأغراض مختلفة.
records.english_definition: The availability of government funds or financial resources that can be readily allocated or used for various purposes.

translations.word: Financial Liquidity|The availability of government funds or financial resources that can be readily allocated or used for various purposes.

records.definition: توقع قدرة الأصول الماليّة أو الاستثمارات على التحويل إلى نقد خلال الفترة القادمة.
records.english_definition: The anticipated ability of financial assets or investments to be converted into cash during the forthcoming period

translations.word: Expected Liquidity|The anticipated ability of financial assets or investments to be converted into cash during the forthcoming period

records.definition: المبلغ المعتمد مع صدور الميزانية للصرف على النفقات العامة والبرامج والمشاريع لسنة الميزانية.
records.english_definition: The amount approved with the issuance of the budget for spending on general expenditures, programs and projects for the budget year.

translations.word: Approved Liquidity|The amount approved with the issuance of the budget for spending on general expenditures, programs and projects for the budget year.

records.definition: أي شخص طبيعيّ، أو اعتباريّ تُقِرّ له أنظمة المملكة بهذه الصفة.
records.english_definition: Any natural or legal person recognized as such under the laws of the Kingdom.

translations.word: Person|Any natural or legal person recognized as such under the laws of the Kingdom.

records.definition: شـركة أو كيـان آخـر يملـك شـخصية اعتباريـة وفـق نظـام الشـركات السـعودي، ولا يُعَدُّ الشـخص الطبيعـيّ شـخصًا اعتباريًـا، ولا يشـمل الشـخص الاعتبـاري شـركات المحاصّـة وفقـًا لمـا هـو معـرف فـي نظـام الشـركات السـعودي.
records.english_definition: A company or other entity that has legal personality under the KSA Companies Law. A natural person is not regarded as a legal person, and a legal person does not include joint venture companies as defined in the KSA Companies’ Law.

translations.word: Legal Person|A company or other entity that has legal personality under the KSA Companies Law. A natural person is not regarded as a legal person, and a legal person does not include joint venture companies as defined in the KSA Companies’ Law.

records.definition: العضو المنتدب، أو عضو مجلس إدارة، أو كبار التنفيذيين أو أي مساهم يمتلك نسبة كبيرة من الأسهم في شركة تكون أو راقها الماليّة مدرجة، أو أي شخص ذي علاقة بشخص ينطبق عليه هذا التعريف.
records.english_definition: The managing director, a director, the senior executives, any shareholder who owns a substantial percentage of shares of a company with a listed securities, or any associate of any such persons to whom this definition applies.

translations.word: Related Person|The managing director, a director, the senior executives, any shareholder who owns a substantial percentage of shares of a company with a listed securities, or any associate of any such persons to whom this definition applies.

records.definition: شخص مسجل لدى الهيئة لأداء وظيفة واجبة التسجيل.
records.english_definition: A person registered with the Authority to perform a registerable function.

translations.word: Registered Person|A person registered with the Authority to perform a registerable function.

records.definition: فرد يُعَيَّنُ لأداء مهامّ  إدارية أو ممثـل شـخصي أو منفـذ لوصية أو حارس قضائيّ أو مُصَفٍّ تـم تعيينـه نظاميًا لغـرض إدارة أو تدبيـر أو تصفيـة أو حـل أمـور الشـخص الخاضـع للضريبـة بمـا فـي ذلـك أمـور الشـخص الطبيعـي المتوفى، ويجب على الشـخص المعيـن إشـعار الهيئـة خطّيًّا بتعيينـه خـلال عشـرين يومًا مـن تاريـخ التعييـن.
